notes.title: Final version 2.13.1 is here now! The online mode is coming to an end.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/47b223c31653776ad5cdbe8a6c3acce6bcc074e7.png[/img]

Hello Dear players,

Warstone’s server has been running for nearly nine years, and now it’s time to let it rest. We’ve released a small update that removes the Online/Offline mode selection. From now on, all players will only be able to play in Offline mode.

We understand that some of you may be in the middle of game playthrough, so we’ll keep the server online for 70 more days, shutting it down on [b]October 3[/b].

If you’d like to continue playing with your Online save progress, simply press Enter on the main menu and [b]type /playserver[/b]. This will let you keep playing as usual — but remember, after October 3, all Online mode save data will be permanently lost.

Thank you for being with us all these years!

[h3]Play with us,[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Our new game TD has been released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/4dc9db703b12de878e252cc2ce6903d77c363451.png[/img]

Hello dear players,

Age of Defense finally leaves Early Access. We worked hard on this game for last years. It took a lot of time and our efforts to finally bring the game to current state.

Age of Defense is a classic TD game in unusual setting of ancient earth. Actually, we made 5 different ages for game. The players start in the Microbe Age and plays forward to Ice Age.
Each Age contains unique bestiary of monsters with cool abilities and etc. In the end of each Age, the player must defeat a Boss. Boss fights are really epic.

There is a cool trailer our artist made.

[previewyoutube=CVp-q5Iwy7Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We added all content we wanted to the game. All defender haves various abilities. So expect various strategy option to pass levels. We made a cool in-game story with 10 animated movies. We prepared epic soundtrack for the game. Each Age contains 3 tracks. Huge skill tree is unlocked after beating Level 3. It allows to power up your tribe during the game.

In other words, we really hope that Age of Defense brings something new to the TD genre.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/603320/Age_of_Defense/

[h2]Age of Defense: Prehistory[/h2]
Also, we prepared a small prologue for the game. It contains 3 unique missions and other cool stuff. So, if you doubt, just try this first. The duration of the game is about 2 hours. It has 15% of main game content. So, if you  like it. You should definitely try the original game.

We even added 7 Steam Achievements to it. We know ,you like it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042480/Age_of_Defense_Prehistory/

We had a long marathon to prepare these titles for release. So, we are going to polish them in future after a little rest. Let us know what you think and please reports about bugs you find. 

[h3]Have a good game![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Warstone Soundtrack is on YouTube & Preview of upcoming games.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XaUkdFftvII;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello there,

We have received an abundance of positive feedback regarding the Warstone soundtrack. It is available in a special [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/768240/Warstone_OST_Artbook_and_Comics/]DLC[/url] along with 30 artbook pages and contains 14 beautiful tracks with 35 minutes of total length. As a special treat, we've decided to create a video showcasing the complete soundtrack. This means you can now enjoy these melodic masterpieces anytime and anywhere, essentially creating a [u]digital monument[/u] for the game!

Our talented artist has crafted simple yet charming visuals to accompany the music. If this initiative is well-received, we are excited about the prospect of sharing soundtracks from our other games on YouTube as well. Thank you for your continued support!

[h3]Upcoming Games[/h3]
Warstone was released more than 5 years ago. We have worked diligently on our new games, and they are both nearing their release. [u]Age of Defense[/u] and [u]Guards II[/u] are set to be released in Q1 of 2024. Let's delve into more details about them.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/603320/Age_of_Defense/

[b]Age of Defense[/b] is a casual tower defense game set in the backdrop of ancient eras.

We've dedicated five years to the development of this game, overcoming numerous challenges along the way. Currently, the game stands at 95% completion, with only the addition of sounds and bug fixes remaining.

We put our souls into that title. The game features five intricately designed and unique worlds, each with its own bestiary. The culmination of each world is marked by an epic Boss Battle. We've crafted a compelling storyline for the game, complemented by eight minutes of animated cartoon videos to narrate it.

[img]http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/AoD/105.gif[/img]

Players are presented with a choice among 24 towers and 5 spells as they defend against hordes of monsters. Our design incorporates over 100 distinct monsters, offering an extensive array of content.

Additionally, Age of Defense boasts a substantial skill tree, featuring over 80 skills in total, all crafted in the style of cave paintings.

The soundtrack, a formidable task undertaken by four different composers, comprises 18 tracks. The challenge lay in the scarcity of references for this particular moment in Earth's history, compelling us to pioneer and create a unique musical atmosphere for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/924f298d2053d95068d274034ebd693cf9b526ad.png[/img]

In essence, we aspire for Age of Defense to make a significant mark in the TD genre. Currently in Early Access, the game is available at a substantial discount. It's worth noting that the game's core elements won't change in the Full release, making this an excellent opportunity to dive in.

Have a good game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394780/Guards_II_Chaos_in_Hell/

[b]Guards II: Chaos in Hell[/b] is a sequel to our first game. 

At a certain juncture, our producer found himself with an abundance of free time and decided to embark on the creation of another game. Forming a new team, we dedicated two years of hard work, leveraging our collective game development experience to expedite the process. As of now, the game stands at 95% completion, with only the tasks of crafting the music and finalizing localizations remaining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/e4c25064a28331a9964c923dd7a7d21e46b588ac.jpg[/img]

Guards I originated as a side project when our main programmer fell ill. Leveraging the graphics and sounds from Warstone, we managed to create a new game swiftly. Guards marked our debut on Steam Greenlight and the first game we shipped to Steam.

However, being our initial endeavor, Guards I exhibited some significant flaws. Learning from this experience, during the development of Guards II, we addressed these issues and implemented better design decisions, resulting in a game that is nearly flawless. With the addition of numerous new mechanics, Guards II feels like an entirely new and impressive game.

The gameplay is seemingly simple—just swap two heroes to make a turn. However, the mechanics are remarkably intricate. Players are compelled to make crucial decisions to sustain their progress. The core concept encourages forward-thinking, resembling a tiny chess game, as some players have noted.

Furthermore, the game unfolds across five distinct underworlds: Egyptian, Asian, Nordic, Slavic, and Christian Hell. This diverse setting introduces players to a plethora of mythological creatures, while the ambiance is enriched by 12 captivating tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/e692077f54e38042560580c9feb81a6865aaf7e7.jpg[/img]

By the way, Guards II boasts truly unique main game mechanics. We are confident you won't find anything like it on Steam. The rules are simple, yet the mechanics delve into profound complexity.

As mentioned, the game is nearly complete. Be sure to add it to your wishlist so you won't miss out.

Play with us,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Final version 2.13 is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/9c165cda03958c4871cf18d10bc653c96bae45e1.jpg[/img]

Hello Dear players,

Finally, we are releasing the last update for Warstone. It contains nothing new but a huge list of fixed bugs. We always wanted to make Warstone immortal, so we spent so much time on polishing it.

We really happy what we brought development of the game to its logical end. It was a great adventure. Development of Warstone began in 2013 as a game for social networks. It evolved later into PC game (thanks to Steam Greenlight). There was a 1 year of Early Access with adding a lot of new stuff to the game. Long awaited release was in 2018. We participated in 2 Steam Daily Promo and had a part in one of Humble Bundle Monthly. We temporarily stopped development of other game to complete Astral Voyage DLC. We translated whole game to 9 other languages. We spent several months to port the game and make full Offline mode. Finally, we fixed all bugs we found. So we proudly send Warstone to its endless independent journey with faces full of happiness.

Thanks for playing our game! Really!

P.S. If you haven't left a review yet, then please do it now. It is the best time for this action. Just write a couple of words about the game! Thanks in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/c87c49d1ff076f832a3549dffb70d3c790ac2601.jpg[/img]

We are still there. The game should be in perfect state. BUT if you will meet a nasty bug which doesn't let you play the game with joy - let us know. We are ready to release hot fixes for the next month.

Also, we added an option to start the game in Windowed mode with selected screen resolution. A lot of people asked for that. Finally, we revised Mac. It works OK.

And we need more players with Linux to be sure the game works fine for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/fc6f500af01f8622deed93dfaf80e7a542281074.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 2.12 is here now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/c69c1097913c3194794d8822671bcf7ab6e88667.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We are keeping polishing Warstone TD. It is pre-final version now. There won't be any new features. We are going to fix remaining bugs.

We added Steam Cloud Saves during development of 2.11 version. It had a big flow what players couldn't keep save files on their PC. So, we made an another system in 2.12. The game uses PC save file as priorited. If there is no save file on the PC (player deleted it or reinstalled game) then the game will download it from Steam Cloud. Now players can keep and share their save files whatever they want and do not fear to lose their progress.

Also, we made Offline mode is default for Chinese players, because they are having troubles often playing Online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/cdf58e19899b71576a1dab365ac51374f5e7a1b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
We revised whole game and made a lot of small tweaks in mission wave fulfillment. Some waves got easier, some got harder. It should make overall difficulty curve of the game is more linear.
[list]
[*]Damage of Witcher was increased by 2. Damage of Inquisitor was increased by 3-4.
[*]Scream ability of Chiroptera gives 2 bonus armor instead of 3 now.
[*]Difficulty of first four missions of the story were slightly weakened. Because we fixed a bug with extra 0-1 damage to all towers and it affected early levels a lot.
[*]The Forest of The Amazons. We reduce amount of air enemies in later waves. Added extra divine stone.
[*]In the Vicinity of the Temple. Two last waves got easier. Added 3 stones to the drops in the top line.
[*]Crossroads. Added 4 divine stones to the drops after Wave 10. Previously player has got much more gold when he could spent.
[*]Small improvements of wave fulfillment of next missions: Ordeal, The Dark Forest, The Outpost. Added some Stones and scrolls to drop rewards. Some waves were weakened.
[*]Fight to the Death was weakened (later waves). Armor of Boomba was weakened by 2. Added more mana balls and Rend scrolls to the drops.
[*]Added 25 gold to the starting gold on On the March mission.
[*]Difficulty of Piedmont missions was reduced in certain waves. Added more scroll drops.
[*]Difficulty of Spirits Gorge was slightly increased.
[*]Difficulty of certain waves of Magical Gem was dramatically reduced. This map was kinda imbalanced.
[*]Starting gold of The Valley mission was increased by 75. Starting waves were weakened. Later waves got buffed.
[*]The Final mission. First waves got stronger. Later waves got easier. Boss was nerfed at all waves.
[/list]
[img]https://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/dlc/english_bottom.jpg[/img]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug when some Skill Points can be lost after resetting Skill tree (Offline Version).
[*]Fixed the bug when players didn't get currency for Hot Air Balloon (Offline Version).
[*]Spirit's Gorge is playable now (Offline Version).
[*]Quest and Steam Achievement for playing 1 PvP battle is automatically completed now. (Both versions).
[*]Lost Soul mob has proper icon now.
[*]Player can't research upgrades of the barrack which is not opened yet now.
[*]Some fixes in the text of English comics.
[*]Removed  a sound of starting new wave when the last mob appeared in Survival missions.
[*]Comics about losing in PvP were placed correctly.
[*]Mines of Destroyer can't be selected now.
[*]Scorch Elemental as a mob has a proper icon now.
[*]Fixed the wrong parameter in info text of Block ability (Troll Champion)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/bf6ea58bc07d0360627165f37e710181ff3f1dcb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patch #10[/h2]
Hello players,
We are working hard during last weeks trying to make Offline mode works perfect. We released 10th patch. We never did so much patches for 1 update. We fixed a lot of bugs and it works almost good.
But we made a mistake. We were working with Steam Cloud and we deleted save files by mistake. We really apologize for it. Steam Cloud will work soon and this never happen again.

We made a package with several save files and added pictures of game progress. Download it, take a look. And use a file which is closer to your previous progress. We hope it can decrease negative feelings.

[url=http://battlecruiser.ru/Warstone_Saves.zip]There is a package with 14 save files.[/url]

[h2]Original Text[/h2]
Hello there,
We have great news. Our programmer worked hard during last months. And he did it. He ported all server code to the client code. So, in this update we have added a complete offline version of the game.
It is a really solid work. It is like to write whole game code from the beginning, because he moved the code from one programming language to another one. He spent more than 400 man hours and more than 4 months in total. We did it, because A LOT of players asked for full offline version. So, here it comes!

Offline mode works as you would play alone in the server and this server is located on your PC. It means, you do not need internet connection at all. There is no lags and no delays. You can move your save_file whatever your want to continue playing.

You can move from Offline to Online version of the game at any time in the main menu. These versions use different save files, so you won't lose your progress if you want to try Offline version. If you want to move your progress from Online version to Offline version - write in the forum.

There is no multiplayer in Offline version. You still can play co-op missions in solo. Also, offline accounts don't participate in leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/c1e9b0896797e6f7265f1cabc243e25d7740b7d5.jpg[/img]

Also, we started making a new guide with all info about game mods and hidden features. It is still in a progress. We are going to finish it in the next update. Section about repetitive rewards are completely finished for now.

You can help us with your ideas what we should add to this guide also.

Original game (online version) is almost bug-free. We have only 20 tasks in our track list. Most of them are so small, so you can't even notice it. We are working on fixing them.

Offline version requires a lot of testing and checking. Basically, it feels like we should test every spell, item, upgrade, ability and check/fix it. So, you can help us with your bug reports. It will speed up the development, so complete bug-free version will come sooner. Thanks in advance.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/a97805bcb02426150f5865c3c1d1161d0fb8bfa3.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

In this update we added Linux port (a lot people asked for it). We tested it, it works fine. 
We are keeping polishing the game. So we fixed a lot of bugs. There will be 2 more updates for Warstone. Please, if you see any bug, report it in the bug thread in the forum. We try to fix it.

[h2]Game changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]As you know the game has an option to command all units attack certain enemy. You need to make double left button click. Now we added an option to target units with a single right button click. It is more common in RTS and just easier to use.
[*]We added all DLC comics to the Artbook DLC. Also, we placed them in the order of appearance. So now they are kind of a small story book with 99 pictures. Also we fixed all typos we found in comics (for all localizations).
[*]We slightly improved efficiency of rune items. Defender Spirit now adds 150% bonus damage instead of 100%. Rune of Meteor deals 200 damage instead of 100.
[*]Also we improved damage of Final Blow ability (Ninja) from 80/155 (min/max) to 100/250 (min/max).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/383ce78413005400cba0dc33706f932b4f1c331d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Thanks to all players who helped us with bug reports. Without your support we could find most of these bugs. Special thanks to Manxome, he wrote a huge post with a lot of info. For now we fixed all we could except 8 bugs. They require more time. They will be fixed in the next update. The game is almost in ideal state. Please, if you see any bug, report in the bug thread in the forum. We try to fix it.

[list]
[*]We discovered that DLC missions on several languages had a missed translation. We fixed it. All text in missions should be translated on all languages now.
[*]Fixed the bug when casting a spell above an item icon would result in the item being collected.
[*]We found that Korean version missed 4 comics and Spanish version missed 1 comics. We added them to the game.
[*]Fixed the bug when all abilities in Spanish used Portuguese text.
[*]Casting a spell on a unit (as a tower) do not highlight the unit.
[*]Fixed the bug when cast of Spirit of Stone Level 3 used two stones instead of one. Also, it has 5 seconds cooldown now to prevent a second cast on the stone in the process of transformation.
[*]Fixed the bug when Enhanced Stone (Level 2 and 3) skill stunned enemies for 4 seconds instead of 8/12 seconds. Also we shortened title of this skill.
[*]Fixed the bug with Unbreakable (Bomber), Fortification (Armadillo), Defensive Aura (Tamplier) abilities. They reduced armor instead of buffing it. Same about Level 8 of Protector ability (Knight).
[*]Fixed the bug when Inquisitor with last damage upgrade got no extra damage at all.
[*]Fixed the bug when an icon which leads to Chapter opened early than it was intended.
[*]Star achievement description for Forest of Gloom (challenge) was corrected.
[*]Added missing texts for skill descriptions in Portuguese: Mana Reserve, Electric Beetle, Assortment, Spirit of Stone, Wisdom.
[*]Name of skill which gives user a spell of summoning Electric Beetle was changed on all languages. It was similar with Warrior Elemental and could be confused.
[*]Corrected description of Tribute, Mysticism, Businessman skills on all languages.
[*]Electric Beetle now has Spell attack ability icon. It had the ability but the icon wasn't shown.
[*]Fixed the difference in Boot Camp (Mercenary) upgrade between description and actual effect.
[*]Fixed the difference in Supernatural (Witcher) upgrade between description and actual effect.
[*]Fixed the difference in the two last levels of Chakram (Shieldmaiden) upgrade between description and actual effect.

[*]Description of Bless (Priestess) upgrade of English and Korean localization was corrected,
[*]Star achievement description of We Came in Peace (Survival) mission of German localization was corrected.
[*]Fixed the bug when Resistance (Witcher) upgrade at 3 last levels didn't give any bonus.
[*]Fixed the bug when Blacksmith Power (Bombardier) upgrade at 4 last levels didn't give any health bonus.
[*]Fixed the visual bug on Fight to the Death mission where enemies didn't use "portal" animation in the end of the path.
[*]Fixed description of Fire Glove item. It should be 150% instead of 150.
[*]Description of Spell attack was corrected in Russian localization.
[*]Fixed the bug when Thick Skin upgrade (Wolf) gave move speed instead of health.

notes.title: Version 2.09 is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/1cb65ae3fd7934bf72fd0329fd403de77d0b96af.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We are keeping polishing the game. 
Our mate composer prepared awesome sounds for all DLC stuff. Unit attacks, mob deaths, abilities, special actions and etc. They are really cool. The game becomes for atmospheric with them. We hope you will like the game more with them.

Also, we slightly changed some sounds of Prophecy campaign. Like Stone aura spell, shoot sounds for Spirit Elementals. Added a sound for activation of Defender Spirit spell. We got player reports and made changes. Finally, we added sounds for procs of Knights, Amazons and Assassins passive abilities.

[h2]What will we do next?[/h2]
[olist]
[*]First of all, we want to try to port the game on Linux. We have got a lot of requests for a past few years. We can't promise anything, but we will give a try.
[*]Another feature we want to add is the Steam Leaderboards. We think it's cool when your friends can see you on first page of the leaderboard.
[*]Finally, our programmer is working on full offline version of the game. It is like playing on other server with only you online. Player could play co-op missions in solo only. Also, both versions will use own save progress. But you can play both version at the same time.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 2.08 is here now! + Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/e87a05e9250162ba4ca1c5df1311b40a527604bd.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

The development of Warstone is coming to its end. We made the DLC. We translated it to all languages.Now we are finishing polishing the game. Anyway, we added 2 new features with this update.

First one is the ability to [b]play co-op levels in solo[/b]. A lot of players asked for this for a long time. It was an uneasy task, but our programmer could make things work. Just create a co-op mission and click the start button. Now anyone can finish them If they couldn't find a mate to beat co-op missions. Go get all Steam achievements!

Secondly, we added [b]Hell+ mode[/b] feature. We made this option for hardcore players who find Warstone too easy game. When you start a game on Hell difficulty then write hell+ xxx in chat. Where xxx is a number from 300 to 5000. So if you write hell+ 5000 then health of enemies will be set to 5000% from default. Try to complete the first mission when the usual boar has 750 health. Can you beat? We sure you can. Enjoy!

Finally, we added improved font style for Polish localisation and improved tower attacks. Now ranged units finish their attack if the targeted unit leaves the attack area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/eba3c4cd4bdb92e839305547f977c0aaeb0a6a89.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
We are finishing polishing the game. In that update we checked and fixed all bugs which had been reported. So it's kinda of a pre-final version. We are going to gather bug reports for another month. We will upload the last update after that. So, if you see any kind of bug, please report about it in the forum. Help us make Warstone bug free and send it to a well-deserved pension.

[list]
[*]When the player starts Astral, The Dark Forest, Secret Level missions on Hell then enemies have 200% of health instead of 300%.
[*]Fixed the bug when items on Spanish were mistakenly misplaced with Portuguese.
[*]Amplification ability (Sorceresses and Demigoddesses ability) works in AoE now.
[*]Sorceresses and Demigoddesses can target air units now.
[*]Mystic casts his Mystic ball properly now. Fixed animation and effect. Changed cast delay. Added impact special effect.
[*]Location of output_log file was changed. Now if the game breaks the system message appears with a hint how to find it.
[*]Fixed the bug when constant clicking on a single unit prevented certain towers from attacking.
[*]First wave of Valley Survival was fixed. It contained several Troll Blademaster by mistake.
[*]Added an icon to a sheep unit (Demigoddess ability).
[*]Ice Whirlwind scroll no longer affects mines (Destroyer ability).
[*]Valley map now have proper icons for entry and exit points in all 3 game stages (Campaign, Challenge, Survival).
[*]Fixed the bug when Nechai's Flower blocked 1 SP from quests even if there were no quests with SP reward. The problem is a hidden quest for getting 75 stars. It is a visible quest now.
[*]Added 2 more New Challenges quests in the list of quests for Nechai's Flower.
[*]Fixed the bug when Betelgeuse lost his health after casting Astral Spikes ability.
[*]Fixed the bug when icons on runes were slightly displaced.[*]Added a sound for purchasing gold ability (Warlord skill).
[*]Elemental Spirit and Warriors now finish an attack even if the targeted unit left the attack area.
[*]Attack projectile of Sorceresses and Demigoddesses  was visually improved.
[*]Explosion effect of Wonder Beetle was improved.
[*]Fixed the bug when a unit which was teleported with a spell from/to warstones didn't lose/get a warstone buff.
[*]Fixed descriptions of Astral Warriors and Defender Spirit spells in English and Russian.
[*]Added sound for a hit of Rushana Magic Arrow ability.
[*]Added sounds to purchasing items in the Treasurer's shop.
[*]Added sound to using items in the backpack.
[*]Added sound to Nechai reborn.[*]Fixed the bug when some visual effects under Dwarfs tower could be seen.
[*]Fixed the bug with a visually broken tutorial at The Battle on the Meadow when playing with 4k game screen resolution.
[*]Fixed the bug when a player could see the third cell of the treasurer market with no item inside in the start of the mission.
[*]Improved visuals of Double Spiral mission.
[*]Fixed the bug with 1 DLC building which didn't have an icon preview.
[*]All DLC buildings are shown at the end of the building list now.[*]Reduced amount of numbers in unit damage to one after ".".
[*]Added missing sounds for Nechai's abilities; Roar and Cleave strike.
[*]Fixed the bug with broken pointers when playing with 4k game screen resolution.
[*]Mailbox building now leads to Co-op thread in the forum.
[*]Warstone building now leads to Guides section in the forum.
[*]Added a missing sound for Armadillo when he uses his ability.
[*]Added a missing sound for Troll Berserker when he uses his ability.
[*]Fixed the bug when the DLC promo banner can't be closed when a player played with low game screen resolutions.
[*]Fixed walk paths in Olymp map.
[*]Fixed the death sound of Valkyrie.
[*]Icons of Beetle and Royal Beetle were misplaced with each other.
[*]Fixed the bug when the last built building still appeared in the construction menu.
[*]Ordeal misson now have proper icons for entry and exit points in all 3 game stages (Campaign, Challenge, Survival).
[*]Fixed the bug when sheep turned into black models.[*]Items in the backpack in the mission are shown properly now. They were slightly displaced.
[*]Fixed the bug when playing some co-op levels (Olymp, Horrors of the Dark Forest, Round Dances) led to a sudden drop from the level !!!
[*]Fixed the bug when buying new maps in Hot Air Balloon could open not three modes.
[*]Frozen stone in the Olymp map works properly.
[*]Fixed a  lot of bugs in the Old School map.
[*]Fixed some bugs which could lead to a stuck in the end of a co-op mission.
[*]Fixed the bug when single maps didn't start with socket.dll option after playing co-op missions.[*]Fixed the bug when The thunderstorm sound keeps playing on the home screen after a mission has ended.
[*]Fixed the bug when playing co-op game with Auto City mode ON could occur a stuck the game in the end of mission.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes of Patch#1[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bug with broken campaign PvP missions was fixed.
[*]Bug with Stone Explosion spell should be fixed.
[*]The bug when players couldn't start wave in solo co-op mission was fixed.
[*]The bug when player couldn't create co-op solo mission of Challenge and Survival difficulty was fixed.
[*]The bug with rounded lifebars was fixed (after that the game was completely unplayable)
[/list]
[b]Play with us,[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 2.07 is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/27d267cea647ecd1cd6e40c0f1cff86486a42087.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We added last language in this update. The Korean translation was made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dollppin]Jaeik[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/NyancoChannel]Nyanco Chanel[/url]. Jaeik translated the original game and improved the text several times, so it should be great.
Also, our fan [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198041612482]Grzegorz[/url] corrected the whole Polish translation. He made more than 400 changes in the text.
We have added names of these men to game credits. Thanks for helping us!

This update doesn't bring something really new, but we made a lot of fixes in game balance. Check the lists below.

Also we lowered the difficulty of the Final mission of Chapter 1. Several players complained of a sudden increase of difficulty compared to the previous missions.

[h3]Units Changes[/h3]
We have gathered a lot of information about towers and their usability. Most of users prefers one towers to another. So, we decided to make unpopular towers more useful.
[list]
[*]Scorch Elemental and Plasma Elemental attack speed was changed from 3.75 to 2.25 seconds. Gold price was reduced by 25 and 40. Base damage was incresed by 2-3 and 5.
[*]Attack speed of Monks and Mystics was  reduced by 0.05 seconds.
[*]Damage of Knights was increased by 3-9. Gold price was increased by 5.
[*]Damage of Knight Templars was increased by 25. Gold price was increased by 10.
[*]Damage of Witchers was increased by 1.
[*]Damage of Inquisitors was increased by 4.
[*]Attack speed of Predators and Deathmongers was changed from 1.9 to 1.25 seconds. Gold price was increased by 10 and 20.
[*]Damage of Shieldmaidens was increased by 7.
[*]Damage of Valkyries was increased by 15.
[*]Gold price of Priestesses was increased by 5.
[*]Amplification spell of Sorceresses and Demigoddesses applies with every attack in a small area now.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/c87c49d1ff076f832a3549dffb70d3c790ac2601.jpg[/img]

[h3]Skills Changes[/h3]
When Astral Voyage add-on came, it increased total amount of skill points significantly, so it was hard to change a skill build. In previous updates we improved skill system. We added an option to remove a single skill with right mouse button. If this action is unavailble then the game shows which skill blocks an action. Reset skill button reset skills of one class only now. All these changes were asked by players and we implemented them. Now we think the system is easy to change your skill build. We hope players will praise these change.

Also we made a lot of changes in skills. We made unpopular skills stronger. There is the list below.
[list]
[*]Faerie Fire and Sorceressess skills now work for Sorceresses and Demigoddesses.
[*]Colleagues skill now works on Cannoneers and Destroyers as well.
[*]Lightning Sword gold price was reduced from 35 to 25. Ability cooldown was reduced from 25 seconds to 20 seconds. Damage was increased from 135 to 175. Duration of slow effect was increased by 50%.
[*]God's Hammer gold price was reduced from 50 to 40. Damage was increased from 60 to 75.
[*]Death Strike gold price was reduced from 65 to 50. Ability cooldown was reduced from 60 seconds to 40 seconds. Damage was increased from 25 to 30.
[*]Magic Chakram gold price was reduced from 90 to 70. Ability cooldown was reduced from 90 to 55 seconds. Armor reduction was increased from 5 to 10. Damage was increased from 75 to 95. Duration of armor reduction effect was increased by 100%.
[*]Corrosive Shells gold price was reduced from 40 to 25.
[*]Enchanted summoned skill stun duration was increased from 3/6/9 seconds to 4/8/12 seconds. Area of effect was slightly increased.
[*]Aura of Stone spell. Attack speed bonus was increased from 25% to 33%. Slow effect was increased from 24% to 30%. Damage bonus effect was improved from 40% to 66%. Cooldown of spell was increased from 60 to 70 seconds.
[*]Stone explosion damage was increased from 175/225/350 to 200/250/400. Armor reduction effect was increased from 10 to 20. Armor reduction duration was increased by 100%.
[*]Slowing stones skill duration was increased from 8/8/12 to 12/12/18 seconds. Area of effect was increased by 20%.
[*]Contract skill recall time was increased from 400%/850%/1400% to 600%/1100%/1750%.
[*]Mason skill cooldown changed from 120/80/45 seconds to 100/55/35 seconds.
[*]Keeper skill chance increased from 10%/20%/30% to 13%/27%/40%.
[*]Bomb spell damage was changed from 100/125/150 to 125/150/200.
[*]Gold Rush spell duration was increased from 8/8/12 to 12/12/16 seconds. Area of effect was increased by 33%.
[*]Fireball damage was rescaled from 55/55/80 to 70/70/100. Burn damage was increased from 0/2/3 to 0/3/5. Burn duration was increased from 10/15 seconds to 14/21 seconds.
[*]Lightning damage was increased from 100/135/175/225 to 100/140/190/250.
[*]Static Charge radius (seeking closest tower) was increased by 40%.
[*]Base radius of teleportation was increased by 25%.
[*]Storm duration was increased from 9/12/12 seconds to 13/13/18 seconds.
[*]Firewall damage per seconds was increased from 35/35/55 to 50/50/75.
[*]War Fire bonus damage was rescaled from 30%/60%/100% to 50%/100%/150%.
[*]Minituarize duration was increased from 8/12/12 seconds to 10/15/15 seconds. Area of effect on Level 3 was increased by 15%.
[*]Thunderstorm damage was changed from 25/25/40 to 35/35/50. Armor reduction effect was improved from 4 to 12. Duration of effect was increased from 8 seconds to 20 seconds.
[*]Damage of Meteor (Meteor Shower spell) was increased from 100 to 175. Burn damage was increased from 4 to 10.
[*]Ancestor's Spirits bonus damage was rescaled from 30%/30%/45% to 40%/40%/60%. Manacost was increased by 5. Area of effect was increased by 25%.
[*]Owl's Wisdom Manacost reduction was increased from 20 to 40.
[*]Carry Over mana bonus was increased from 5/10/15 to 7/11/15.
[*]Defender Spirit rune item. Cooldown was reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds. Manacost was changed from 15 to 10. Spell duration was increased from 15 to 35 seconds.
[*]Meteor rune item. Damage was increased from 100 to 175. Manacost was reduced from 30 to 20. Burn damage was increased from 2 to 10.
[/list]
[img]http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/207.gif[/img]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Thanks for reporting in the forum about bugs. Without you support we couldn't find them all. There is a list of bugs we fixed.

[list]
[*]Fixed the critical bug when player got negative rewards after resetting skills several times. [b](Players who have negative values now, please, add Rurik to friends. He will help)[/b]
[*][b]Mac version[/b] of the game should work properly now.
[*]Fixed the bug in multiplayer games when joined player got stuck in the end of the session.
[*]Enemy towers can be opened in encyclopedia now.
[*]Description of items in the backpack and treasure market shows real numbers now.
[*]Fixed the bug when click on the old mage could open comics and a dialogue at the same time.
[*]Addded missing texts of Portuguese skills
[*]Fixed the bug when Demigoddesses could polymorph dwarf mines.
[*]Fixed wrong description of Execution ability in Russian localisation.
[*]Player do not get "Impossible to position" message in the start of the game anymore (it happened because of Auto-city mode).
[*]Fixed descriptions of attack types in Russian localisation.
[*]Fixed descpriptions on tower info in Portuguese translation.
[*]Visual and sound fixes of Lightning Sword ability perfomance (Witcher skill).
[*]Fixed Scully name in English localisation.
[*]Bonus damage from Warlord skill is applied to bonus damage now.
[*]Added German transaltion for 10-12 hotkeys.
[*]Fixed the bug with Rating menu when title name was oversized in Spanish and Portuguese translations.
[*]Fixed the bug with Start game text button in Arema of French Description. It was oversized.
[*]Changed the text in Hot Air Balloon message when no maps available in English localisation.
[*]Fixed typos in German promo banner.
[*]The Order of Knigh Templars was shortened in English localisation.
[*]Fixed description of Armor Aura of Troll Chanter.
[*]Fixed the bug with %val instead of number in Gold Chains spell.
[*]Fixed the bug with %val instead of number in Defender Spirit spell.
[*]Fixed the bug with %val instead of number in Lightning spell in Chinese localisation.
[*]Fixed wrong number in the description of Stone Fist spell.
[/list]

[h2]Play with us,[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

Storm duration was increased from 9/12/12 seconds to 13/13/18 seconds.

Damage of Meteor (Meteor Shower spell) was increased from 100 to 175. Burn damage was increased from 4 to 10.
Ancestor's Spirits bonus damage was rescaled from 30%/30%/45% to 40%/40%/60%. Manacost was increased by 5. Area of effect was increased by 25%.
Owl's Wisdom Manacost reduction was increased from 20 to 40.
Carry Over mana bonus was increased from 5/10/15 to 7/11/15.
Defender Spirit rune item. Cooldown was reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds. Manacost was changed from 15 to 10. Spell duration was increased from 15 to 35 seconds.
Meteor rune item. Damage was increased from 100 to 175. Manacost was reduced from 30 to 20. Burn damage was increased from 2 to 10.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/58e11fcc63acb8925e36f6efb13e59403d9050f5.jpg[/img]
Hello there,

We added 3 more languages for DLC. It is Spanish localisation made by[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/airuamano/] Eugenio[/url] It is Portuguese localisation made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/jbaciotti ]Jose[/url]. Finally, our mate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198393593777/]Marcin[/url] completed Polish translation. These people translated the original game, so I am pretty sure the game is translated great.

So, 7 languages for DLC are in the game and 3 left. French is almost done, Chinese is half done. We have a light problem with Korean. If you are Korean native speaker and like Warstone, please help us with Korean translation. Leave a comment or add Rurik to friends.

Also, in the next update we will add a minor feature, Hell+ difficulty. It will allow players to set enemies HP to the value they want. Should be fun for hardcore players!

notes.title: Major Update! Version 2.04 is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/b7db67a21f54c201e937a0e64e4950fcc1ac5f9e.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

First of all, we added improved and edited English localisation made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/rea54321]Andreea[/url]. She did it a great job. We worked for about 1 month to discuss and fix all unclear phrases and fix typos. She said after she finishes nobody will ever complain about bad English localisation. I believe her.

Also we added Deutsch localisation for DLC made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/tschilumbu]Raffael[/url] and Japanese localisation made by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/onigirin]Yuji[/url]. They finished translations earlier when we expected,we include it in this update. Say thanks to these great guys if you use German or Japanese :D

Translation of DLC content of other 6 languages (Chinese, Portuguese, French, Korean, Polish and Spanish) is on a way. We finish our games.

Also, our mate composer is making sounds for all towers and enemies from DLC. They should come with next update too.

[img]https://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/dlc/english_middle.jpg[/img]

We changed Astral Voyage DLC Store presence. We added new banners and comics to the description. It is available on English, German, Russian and Japanese languages now. In our opinion it looks very cool now.

notes.title: Major Update! Version 2.03 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/6741a24a64061cf4ecf7f17448a2983d931134d3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Co-op improvements[/h2]

In this update we added the rest of Astral Voyage DLC missions, End of Story Survival; Narrow Island Survival; Crystal Swirls Survival; Double Spiral Challenge and Survival. This update took a lot of time because we fixed and tested a lot of bugs. You can see a huge list of bug fixes below.

The development of Warstone is nearing completion. We are translating the text of DLC content to other languages and making sounds for new units and abilities. We are polishing the game as well. If you find any bug even a minor one, please post in the forum about it.

Anyway, there comes some cool features. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/946d49b412ee7b2e2eba4d473149635a335e08bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug when game got stuck if player opened a menu in PvP missions
[*]Fixed the critical bug in the game scenario/tutorial after completion of Prologue mission. Player could accidentally click on wrong building and got stuck.
[*]Fixed the bug when Valkyrie didn't receive last levels of Chakram ability
[*]Base damage of Shieldmaidens and Valkyries was increased by 2-4
[*]Warcraft skills give proper values now 15%/30%/45%. It gave old values 10%/25%/45%
[*]A lot of damage buffs now show damage with fractional quantities
[*]Reward for killing an enemy was moved to dropped coins when a unit was killed with Midas Touch
[*]Second cast of Berserk ability now resets number of shots
[*]Skill for decreasing spell duration now work for scrolls as well
[*]We changed a way of showing game version in the left bottom corner. Now it is easier to see where  you play (on server or with Socket.dll)
[*]Treasurer skill no longer reduces price of summoning attacking units in PvP missions
[*]If a player tries to use Teleportation skill far from ability range when spell doesn't go on cooldown but shows a warning tool-tip instead
[*]Carry over skill worked wrong. It reduces manacost of all abilities after each spell use. It works properly now.
[*]Fixed the bug when Glove of Fire (item) didn't work
[*]Fixed the bug when it wasn't possible to complete an achievement in the End of story mission because 1 Astral Boar wasn't scored
[*]Fixed the bug when skill Potency (increases duration of spells) was apllied 2 times, If you had level 1 of skill, player got 20%*20%=44% extra duration
[*]Removed a white line in the animation of fire of Inquisitor barracks
[*]Windrun ability of Amazon in PvP works properly now
[*]Removed extra frame in the walking animation of Astral Boar
[*]Fixed the bug when mines of Destroyers was destroyed right after deployment
[*]Sorcerers can't longer transform mines into sheeps
[*]Small visual improvement in the city. Cloud nearby Gold Mine now stand in front of it. Looks much better.
[*]Fixed the bug when a warstone of toad gave a discount for SuberUberMega upgrade
[*]Fixed the bug when placing the game on pause didn't pause a star achievement with a timer.
[*]Colored and grey icons of Valkyrie were synchronized
[*]Paths in the Map of Adventures were moved to proper place
[*]Fixed a font of title of Caravan building
[*]Fixed the bug in Two Mountains mission when player couldn't place new towers after destroying default ones
[*]Time is shown with fractional quantities in ability descriptions
[*]Fixed a wrong number in Gold Chains skill description
[*]Fixed a visual bug with grass in The Forest Of Gloom mission
[*]Fixed the bug when timer on skull icon didn't work in PvP missions
[*]Fixed a star achievement for The Dwarven Shooting Range
[*]Removed sound effect for Astral Boar in the Encyclopedia
[*]Double Shot skill description fix
[*]Improved Russian localisation in certain parts of the game (Gold chains description, Arena tooltip, Skeleton Nechai name and etc.)
[*]Removed excess letters in some tooltips (like вжхвжх) in Russian localisation
[/list]
[b]Play with us,[/b]

notes.title: Major Update! Version 2.02 is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/3475bbec554969e92023bbd83e45ac6d7f9f6ea0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Co-op improvements[/h2]
First of all, we finally found and fixed the nasty bug which made the game stuck in end of win/lose of all co-op missions. It wasn't easy, really. Our programmer spent several days on this task.

We added the last co-op map in Warstone universe. It is Double Spiral mission. It is the biggest map in Warstone, contains 2 roads and a lot of space for stone placement. An Idea of spirals should motivate teammates to communicate better if they want to pass this mission. For now, we added only story mode of this map. Harder version comes later and they will be nearly insane.

There were an annoying bug with numbers of rewards for co-op missions. There were displayed wrong in several places. We made some changes in the code. It should show right numbers everywhere now.

[list]
[*]Achievements in co-op mission are shown for both players if at least 1 player didn't have it
[*]Green potions in co-op missions give proper values now. It was halved in co-op missions
[*]Counter of online player and current games works properly now
[*]Countdown timer in arena was improved
[*]Fixed the bug when the game didn't show passed missions in arena if they were passed without achievement
[*]Fixed the bug when player should click 2 times on reward button to close reward window
[*]Hell Boars in Sold School Map Survival (85 wave) are killable now
[*]Small fixes of button status in Map creation and Map created menus
[*]Fixed the small bug when name of player in co-op could changed on single_player
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/8f95a46466568b1b67566bcb896ad9110aa4b52b.png[/img]

[h2]Visual improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Visuals of Meteor spell look much better now, especially in Astral missions
[*]Lost Soul troll carries crystal swords now in both forms. Also, we added visual effect when it changes form
[*]Gases after death of Freak enemy exist full duration
[*]Wonder Beetle ability animation improvements
[*]Added new visual effect for Poison Cloud (appears after death of Big Beetle)
[*]Arrow pointer of description tooltips points at right direction now
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Midas Touch spell fix. It killed Astral Soarer, Crystal Soarer, Astral Wolf, Elemental Spirit, Elemental Warrior, Lost Soul enemies visually, but they were still alive but invisible and could took life.
[*]Numbers of damage in description of scrolls show real numbers now
[*]Fixed the bug when summoned Scorch Elemental (Nechai ability) didn't used player's skill (like damage bonuses and etc)
[*]Fixed the bug when Scully mob summoned from Scullhead didn't use Astral Curse ability
[*]Added visual effect (small black cloud) for Destroyer attack
[*]Improvements of resetting one skill option
[*]Increased text field in Construction menu 
[*]Fixed the bug when first summoned units could get gold abilities for free
[*]We returned missing scenario/tutorial for all DLC missions
[*]Fixed the bug when some spells remained in spellbook even after skill reset
[*]Fixed the bug when Scorch Elementals didn't used Avatar abilities at certain maps
[*]Beetle and Astral Soarer mobs are more easily targetable with spell cursor
[*]Goblet building related bug fixes
[*]Added missing sound effect for Ore Samples building
[*]Crystal Swirls visual improvements
[*]Fixed a typo in Architect tooltip of Russian localisation
[*]Fixed a typo in tooltip of arrow to Astral of Russian localisation
[*]Reward for starting waves earlier is displayed right if bravery skill learnt
[*]Fixed the bug when enemies start walking being under stun effect upon getting damaged
[*]Some system texts improvements
[*]Crying Rushana building uses right link now (goes to Leave a review on DLC)
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update! Version 2.01 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/ef6e2928cd32ed15fe806e55dcaa5598dc051da6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Skill points system improvements[/h2]

First of all, we added new building, Nechai's Flower. It allows to buy extra SP. We set SP limit of 140 for all players. A few players duo different reasons had more than 140 SP. We manually reset their SP and reduced their amount to 133. So, all players have equal possibilities in co-op and PvP battles now.

We added an ability to reset asingle skill with right mouse button. The game was designed for 60-70 SP. It was doubled with DLC release, so sometimes it was really annoying to reset skills and choose them again. A lot of people asked for this feature. It wasn't an easy task, but we did it. 

Also, we added another small feature. When you press Reset of Skills button then you reset only skills of chosen class.

Also, we added 99 level.

We hope, these changes will make Warstone more pleasant game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/eacb2f79e1a4c98cb7483137196c7df8f6cf0e82.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update! Version 2.00 is available now.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/586721fe937b39750b5fe2a5bb0afc6aee2a6bff.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hello there,[/h2]

This update came much faster than previous, but it still adds a lot to the game.

First of all, we added last mithril abilities for level 4 units. Destroyer got Mines ability. It allows to place mines on the ground which damage and stun enemies. One Destroyer can have 3 mines placed at the same time. Demigoddesses get Polymorph ability. They can transform enemies into harmless sheep reducing their armor, magic resistance and movement speed. It also disables their active abilities. Finally, Plasma Elemental has got Death Ray ability. If unit dies under effect of Plasma Ray, it explodes. Nearby units get damaged and slowed. It is extremely strong ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/cdf58e19899b71576a1dab365ac51374f5e7a1b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]New PvP stuff[/h2]
We removed 9999 mifril price for barracks of Wolves and Eagles. Now you can build them, obtain achievements and summon units in PvP games. Another 10 units also available in PvP now.

We rebalanced some units before DLC release. In this update we balanced their PvP forms as well. We changed Knight Tamplier, Inquisitor, Spirit and Warrior Elemental. They have another price and stats now.

Also we fixed some bugs with PvP units. For example, Armored Wolf had wrong movement speed,  Sorcerer cost more than she did in tower form and etc.

[b]New units and their abilities[/b]
[olist]
[*]Monk and Mystic have Phase Shift ability with 15% / 20%  chance (it allows to avoid any damage). Mystic also can regenerate over time.
[*]Predator and Deathmonger have Crystal Shield ability which absorbs damage. Deathmonger also cast Execution ability which stuns towers. 
[*]Cannoneer and Destroyer have Mortar ability. It shoots projectiles at PvP units at other roads. Destroyer also stuns towers in small area for a short period of time.
[*]Sorcerer and Demigodess have Medium ability (moves to astral on getting damage) and improved Healing. Demigoddesses also get Polymorph and Astral Burst abilities (move all allies to astral upon death).
[*]Scorch and Plasma Elementals have Avatar ability which increases armor and magic resistance with low health. Plasma Elementals also significantly slow all nearby towers when it dies.
[*]Astral Soarer and Crystal Soarer have Phase Shift ability with 3 seconds cooldown. Crystal Soarer also spawns little crystal creepers in getting damage.
[*]Finally, Rocket and Turbo wolves can increase their movement speed. Turbo wolf also leaves a Smoke Cloud which helps allies to evade some attacks.
[/olist]
[i]Also, we added Worse than Death Survival and Challenges of The Power of Love and Crystal Swirls.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/4df85b57943cc2a2d38f1e16f8a801be738ef03f.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes and other stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lightning scroll spell damage was increased from 200 to 300
[*]Fixed the red error when starting We Came in Piece Survival mission
[*]Added range of attack for all astral co-op missions
[*]There were a bug with time between attacks of Plasma Elemental. It was doubled. So basically, it was 6 seconds between attacks. We fixed bug and set it to 4. So, it attacks faster now.
[*]Fixed the bug with retargeting of towers which froze their attack
[*]Economy skill no more reduces prices in the city market
[*]Betelgeuse in The End of Story mission couldn't be killed with Midas Touch now
[*]Fixed the bug when menu of skills couldn't be scrolled after wining The Lair mission
[*]Armageddon spell price was increased from 5 to 45 mana in The Final mission to prevent miss casts
[*]Wave 51 Boss was weakened in the secret level.
[*]Fixed the bug when the last upgrade icon in Workshop was shown wrong
[*]Attack animation of Destroyer was improved. It had a few excess frames
[*]Visual of Crystal Swirls was improved
[*]Fixed the bug when Owl of Wisdom could stop raising max level
[*]Execution ability visual improvements
[*]Added missing letter in word Construction in the Architect building
[*]Added missing frame to stand animation of Demigoddesses
[*]Visual fixes of Electrobug
[*]Death animation of sheep was fixed
[*]Fixed the bug when polymorphed Mutant still could summon Shroomies
[*]Added info icon for Scully mob
[*]Visual fixes of Spirit and Warrior Elementals
[*]Fixed the bug when player could target polymorphed sheep with magic
[*]Fixed the bug when health bars of enemies were missing sometimes
[*]Polymorph now also disable regeneration of affected units
[/list]

P.s. In the next update we will add Nechai's Flower, it is the building where players can buy extra SP. A lot of players asked for this feature.

[b]Play with us,[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update 1.98 is here. DLC campaign is finished!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/7e0666486e22a67335c4e7e87f9297bcba69c9b3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello there,[/h2]

We want to apologize for such a long delay before an update. We had several unexpected things which we need to deal with before we could continue the development.

Anyway, it is here and it is ready. First of all, we added 2 last story DLC missions. The Lair is maze level. Actually, it is the biggest maze level in the game with a lot of possible ways of placing stones. By the way, our programmer improved the code for maze building, So players could build the longest maze with 50 or more stones. We hope you enjoy that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/ed385a1ee2473c2a4d1c41197c8a0d300ff08549.jpg[/img]

The Power of Love is the last story mission of Warstone. You start only with Nechai and debt of 750 gold. There are 3 long roads which converge at the point of Sleeping Rushana. So, you need to be everywhere to win. Later stages you will have so high gold income, so you could build/place up to 50 towers.. Also, Evil Betelgeuse casts bad spells on you. So, this map is full of action. We hope you will like it.

Besides of missions, we added last 2 battle units. It is Executioner (an upgrade of Predator) and Plasma Elemental (an upgrade of Scorch Elemental). They are the strongest and the most expensive units in the game. Also, a bunch of new upgrades comes with Tavern level 2 to 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/08523cd449985f61011b32de0946ae3f399adcc5.jpg[/img]

We fixed Hot Air Ballon and we added 2 astral co-op missions, Narrow Island and Crystal Swirls. They have different difficulty and contain enemies from Astral world only. Anyway, players who don't have DLC can play the level. 

We added Challenge mode of Awakening, Death Trap and Survival mode of The Frontier, We Came in Peace and New Allies missions. So, we added 10 missions in total whereas DLC previously had only 10 missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/7234da3fe7f1f7fdbe22dbee84c538ce7f18e005.png[/img]

[h2]Scorch Elemental changes[/h2]

We have got several reports about weakness of new Elemental towers. Yeah, they were weak. So, we made several changes. 

First of all, we increased base damage from 15-15 to 17-18. Secondly, they have armor reduction which stacks, so the longer they attack the stronger effect enemy suffer. Thirdly, upgrade for summoning cost comes after you pass 8th mission, so Elementals will be cheaper. Finally, Scorch Elemental now has similar to Witcher ability. It increases damage with every second. Actually, it increases the damage by 2 every second. So after attacking same target for 9 seconds, damage dealt is doubled. Not bad.
The strong point of Elemental level 3 & 4 is to kill the big and tough enemies. We think, it fits this role perfectly.
P.s. Elemental level 4 will have awesome mithril ability which we will add in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/a87948f0b30d0bd347d87ce98d34cb336c63686a.png[/img]

[h2]Bug reports[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enemies in Maze level chose better ways now
[*]Fixed the bug when players couldn't build very long mazes and got "Impossible to Position" message all the time
[*]Fixed the critical bug when killing Scully mob with Spear Throw led to game crash.
[*]Fixed the bug when cast of Purge spell removed Bounce ability from Shieldmaidens and Valkyries
[*]Name of Skullhead mob is shown properly now (was with Russian letters previously)
[*]Fixed the bug when fast enemies slowed down on corners
[*]Visual effects of Elemental Warrior on Night map were corrected
[*]Fixed the bug when first frame of attack animation of Priestess got lost on the game screen
[*]A lot of visual fixes of attack animation of Plasma Elementals. 
[*]Fixed the bug when damage spells like Lightning didn't deal damage to Crystalbacks
[*]Fixed speed movement bonus animation for Boards (Chapter 1)
[*]Fixed the bug when retargeting didn't change a target of Plasma Elemental
[*]Predator and Executioner mobs now have red color backs
[/list]

[h2]About next update[/h2]
DLC is almost finished. We will add all PvP units and their buildings in the next update. The building where you can buy more SPs also comes with next update. Finally, we will add remaining mithril abilities/upgrades for last units (Polymorph, Mines and etc.). After that we will just need to add sounds, translate texts to other languages and fix reamaining bugs

Play with us,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5c16275f822181e369256a46174de79dbba6dae1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tech Update 1.94 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/f3787b2f6d44c07227ea489fca60702c988fcbc3.jpg[/img]


Hello there,

it is a techical update with no new content. We have got several reports about crashes last days. We are trying to do our best.

First of all, we uploaded x64 version of the game instead of x86. We expect it should fix crashes with "Too many heap sections". If you had them before, tell us in future did it help or now.
Be aware, that you need x64 OS to launch the game. We hope nobody uses it in 2020 :)

Secondly, we made special server for seeking co-op bugs. Our testers constantly play the game in search of trigger of "Connection to server lost" in co-op games. We hope to find them in next 1-3 days.

Also, we fixed some minor bugs with Hidden Texts, economist skills and etc. They are not so important now.

UPDATE
Finally, we found the reasonof crashes with red lineConnection to server lost and fixed them.
1) First could occur when a player upgraded Monk tower to Mystic tower after Summong Fury buff faded off.
2) Another bug occured when ghost wolfs were damaged by area damage of Bombardiers.
3) We found a glitch which could occur crashes during co-op missions. For now, co-op battles should be extremely more stable

Stay with us.

This is a technical update. We fixed all bugs which came with DLC release. We fixed more then 35 bugs and prepared a release of 5th and 6th missions. Map visuals and comics are ready. We finished discussion of new abilities, so we just need to draw effects and check game balance.

We improved visuals of second and third missions of Astral Voyage. Also, we changed parameters for Hell difficulty. Also there were a bug, they didn't worked at co-op missions. Everything should work fine now.

notes.title: Astral Voyage add-on is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/8d95ad0d46c1144721aa5838f1fc6bea2186acaa.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We have worked hard for last 3 months to release this add-on. We didn't make all we wanted  but we couldn't postpone release anymore. So we released Astral Voyage add-on in kind of Early Access state. Please keep it in mind purchasing the game. We will finish add-on main story in 4-6 weeks and we will keep improving it. Buy the DLC now if you want to support us, developers of Warstone.

Originally we planned to make Tower Power Pack. We wanted to add just new towers. That's all. Yeah, it is only 15% from what we are going to add. We decided to do it because we wanted to complete the main story about Nechai. Also a lot of players asked to make another chapter. It helped us to make a decision to make the add-on completed.

It is the reason why it took so much time. Sorry for the delay. Hopefully, you will enjoy it a lot how you did playing original Warstone.

We want to say [b]thanks to all players[/b] who helped us to make this add-on alive by playing, testing, sharing thoughts, advising and writing reviews. It couldn't be done without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/dcfe983d7b85447ed870d7a0d89f676f70f2ccbc.png[/img]
[h1]What is available now?[/h1][list]
[*]4 missions in astral setting. They look more diverse than missions from original campaign.
[*]19 new enemies with absolutely new abilities and parameters. Prepare to look for new strategies to pass levels.
[*]Continuation of [b]Nechai story[/b]. It means there are a lot of quests with rewards. Also we added 14 comics for the first part of the story. Our artist`s skills have been improved for last 2 years, so comics should look awesome.
[*]New towers. You will get access to Monk (Level 3 melee tower) with ability to make combo strikes and deal an extra damage which depends on max enemy health. Predator (Level 3 archer tower) has an ability to attack all targets simultaneously in the area. Also, it reduces their magic resistance. Sorcerer is Level 3 Magic Tower. She applies amplification ability with each attack. It increases incoming damage. Finally, new Level 3 Siege tower Cannoneer has a huge level of damage and Blast wave ability which stuns all nearby enemies for a short period of time . More towers will appear in the next update.
[*]Magic Academy Level 3. Improve power of your favorite spells
[*]Owl of Wisdom is a new building which increases max level from 60 to 99 and also rewards with some skill points. A lot of players asked for it.
[*]Ancient runes II increases experience gathering for extra 50%
[*]Tavern is a new building which increases damage of ALL towers by 5% for each level of building. Only level 1 is available now
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/28a0a0e44436cd181dfe5c464781cc02986d0476.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is unavailable but it comes in future updates.[/h2][list]
[*]The last 4 missions of the add-on.
[*]Remaining 6 towers. Level 4 of Melee, Archer, Siege and Magic towers and Level 3 & 4 of Elemental tower.
[*]The end of the story with 15 new comics
[*]4 PvP towers. Level 3 & 4 of Eagle and Wolf towers. Also we will add PvP option for other DLC towers
[*]Challenge and Survival modes for 8 new maps
[*]Localisation to other 8 languages
[*]Sound effects for towers, units and new buildings
[*]Mithril abilities for  all Level 4 towers
[/list]

Surely, all those things we will add to the game. Another content depends on your activity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/d8fc8c8bb41f7bab3d869448b801013110161dbc.png[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/2269195350112474293/

Also, please share your thoughts about DLC in Steam Review. [b]They help us a lot![/b]

Your Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Major Update! Version 1.22 is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/ecc6dfc63d04daf2c17392218fad50faa157e882.jpg[/img]
[h1]What's new[/h1]
Hello there,
The update is the last one before the release of the DLC. The preparation has been already done. So DLC comes in 7-10 days.

All players who meet requirements should get new quests and buildings. Buildings will be available for construction when DLC releases.[list][*]Players who passed The Dark Forest missions should get new dialogue with the old mage which leads to "Key to Astral" quest and give "Ore Samples" building.
[*]Players who have Magic Runes II on Tree of Life should get "Ancient Runes II" building  and "Spell of greater experience" quest .
[*]Players who have Book of Arcane Knowledge building should get "Call of the spirit" quest  and "Spirit of Wisdom" building.
[*]We added new colorful banner for people who doesn't have DLC and click on the Chapter 2 button.
[/list]

There will be only English and Russian texts for all new DLC stuff for first few weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/5d483fc38e2bc839d085929a678fa3eb04e25be1.jpg[/img]
[h1]About upcoming DLC[/h1]
Finally, we can tell a few words about DLC. It will be called Astral Voyage. Originally we planned just add new towers and some cool features, but we decided to finish Nechai story. It is the reason why it takes so long. Astral Voyage is kinda Chapter 2. There will be a story with comics, quests, dialogues. There will be 33 new enemies. It is more than original game has. 8 new maps in new setting. So, it should be fun. We hope at least. It will cost only 7.99$.

We decided to release DLC in unfinished state, because we have already failed all deadlines. At start there will be available only 4 of 8 missions, no challenge and survival modes. DLC will be available with English and Russian languages only. We plan to add another 4 missions in 1 month, complete challenge and survival mods in 2 months, add other 8 languages in 2-3 months.

So, DLC is unfinished, you are aware, please buy it only in case if you are OK with it and want to support us. We fulfill our promises. The game will be finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/28a0a0e44436cd181dfe5c464781cc02986d0476.jpg[/img]
[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
We were forced to change characteristics of certain towers because 10 new towers will be added in DLC. They affect gameplay significantly.

We made melee units stronger, especially Level 4 melee units. Also we made the, more expensive to compare with Elemental towers Level 3 & 4. Price and damage of Valkyrie and Ninja were also raised a little. Price of Bombardiers was reduced significantly, we hope it makes this unit more popular. 

Finally, we were forced to make Elemental towers cheaper and weaker, because Elemental towers 3 would be disproportionately expensive. For example, Old Inquisitor cost 180 in total when Warrior Elemental cost 300. If we don't change anything, Elemental Level 4 would cost 5 strongest melee units. It is not great.[list][*]Damage of Knight was increased by 2-7
[*]Damage of Witcher was increased by 1-2
[*]Damage of Shieldmaiden was increased by 0-3
[*]Base/final price of Knight Templar was increased from 100/90 to 165/155. Base/final attack damage was increased from 38-52 / 57-71 to 66-82 / 85-101
[*]Base/final price of Inquisitor was increased from 85/75 to 145/135. Base/final attack damage was increased from 23-27 / 32-35 to 42-47 / 51-55
[*]Base/final price of Valkyrie was increased from 135/125 to 160/150. Base/final attack damage was increased from 25-37 / 35-47 to 32-47 / 42-57
[*]Base/final price of Ninja was increased from 105/95 to 135/125. Base/final attack damage was increased from 17-21 / 20-23 to 20-23 / 23-25
[*]Price of Bombardiers was decreased by 15 from 75/65 to 60/50
[*]Price of Spirit Elemental  was decreased from 125 to 75. Base/final attack damage was deacreased from 35-55 / 45-65 to 20-30 / 30-40. Attack range was decreased by 50.
[*]Base/final price of Warrior Elemental Spirit was decreased from 190/175 to 115/100. Base/final attack damage was deacreased from 65-115 / 75-125 to 45-65 / 55-75. Attack range was decreased by 50.
[/list][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list]
[*]We updated Mac build
[*]Fixed the bug with star counter
[*]Totem of mithril and stone of teleportation are now work properly. They give resources
[/list]

notes.title: Tech Update. Version 1.20 is here! + Patch #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/7f860641a97399a07956e35a7facf70e366c468f.jpg[/img]

Hey all,
It was a long time since we posted something.

This update is a tech update. It offers nothing new, but fixes a lot of things. Also it is the first uploading of the game for almost a year, so we need to be sure it works fine before we give access to DLC. We temporarily added development console, so we can find all new and old bugs asap. Thanks for playing and helping us.

[h3]General changes and bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*]Resource amount from gathering buildings was increased. Gathering time was increased as well. For example it took 6 hours of battle time for mithril and 2 hours for gold, now it requires 2,5 hours for getting mithril and just 40 minutes to get gold. It should help. Also, we want to notice that gathering depends on battle time (time spent playing battles), not real time.
[*]Mana cost of all magic upgrades was reduced. Mana cost of Earth and Water schools was reduced by half. 
[*]The building in the city now play a sound if you click on it to read comics. It adds greater involvment in the story.
[*]Main menu of the game was dramatically visually improved.
[*]We added a special icon for PvP upgrades, so players wouldn't worry about getting them and thinking they are forced to play co-op missions. 
[*]A lot of UI improvements.
[*]Fixed a bug when dialogue windows blinked while reading them.
[*]Fixed visual bugs of moon well. It was shown filled when it was empty sometimes.
[/list]
[h1]Message from devs[/h1]
[i][b]Guys, you can help us a lot.[/b] If you see development console with red errors, it means you found a bug. You can help us great, if you click on Open file and send output_log file to [u]euler@battlecruiser.ru[/u]with a small explanation when the bug happens. We will fix all found bugs as soon as possible. Thanks in advance![/i]

notes.title: Chapter 2. We need your participation!
notes.content:
Hello there,

It was long time since we posted any info about Warstone because we were extremely busy with Age of Defense. We have some good news. We have been considering an option to change our plans, so we returned to the idea of DLC with Chapter 2. We need your to hear your expectaions and your opinion. Let me tell what we have now.

Artist has drawn all towers.
[list]
[*] Monk Lvl 3 & Lvl 4. Extra upgrade of merceneries
[*] Demonesses. Extra upgrade of huntresses.
[*] Bombardier Lvl 3 & Lvl 4. Upgrade of Snipers
[*] Goddess Lvl 3 & Lvl 4. Upgrade of Priestesses
[*] Astral Eagles Lvl 3 & Lvl 4. Upgrade of Eagles
[*] Rocket Wolves. Upgrades of Armored wolves
[*] Plasma Elementals Lvl 3 & Lvl 4. Upgrade of Elemental Warriors
[/list]

So most of 14 new towers add Level 3 & 4 upgrades for towers who don't have them. It  should open a lot of new tactics. Rifleman weren't popular becauase they took place of 1 stone where you spend 150 gold maximum at this. So using elemantals were more profitable in most cases. Lvl 4 rifleman wil lcost much more, Lvl4 of Elemental gonna be a ultimate weapon. Other units get several featrues. For example Demonesses damage units in area around here and Monk can do devastating damage at single targets.

Also, we have all new buildings for the city drawn. So we can add them easily. We also modelled 6 new missions in astral setting. As we said Chapter 2 is half done. But we don't have enemies (we need about 20 different models for enemies), comics (they take a lot of time to draw them) and approved storyline (dependences of battles/quests/new content. When a quest unlock maps, the map gives another quest and etc).
So we can't make Chapter 2 alive fast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26976525/e44448fc34caec16e892f8f20fb8a59fa93a8e9a.jpg[/img]

We have several options what we can do:
[olist]
[*]Release DLC as a pack of towers. We will add all 14 new towers. Increase max lvl of the player from 61 to 99 or 125 (a lot of people asked for it) and probably add another hard difficulty setting. That all is kinda easy to implement in the game. Can be done in several weeks. It will cost about 5$. 
[*]Release Chapter 2 in unfinished State. We will add 3-5 maps with new enemies, buildings, quests and etc. The rest of Chapter will be locked. We will add new content every 2-4 weeks. It will look like Early access of Chapter. Like we did with Warstone in EA when we started with 8 missions only and added 1 new missions with each new patch. So Chapter 2 will be done in a couple of months. Only English language during will be implemeted the development. We value this option as 10$.
[*]Do nothing now. Wait until release of Age of Defense and start full development of the DLC. It postpones Chapter even more further. Probably it will be never be released.
[/olist]

So, summarazing it. Release complete Chapter II when it is ready look unpromising. We kinda afraid we can spend a lot of time on this DLC and only a few players will buy it.  Option to release a tower pack seem easy to implement, but it doesnt fit our plans to leave a story unfinished. Early Access of Chapter II looks great for us. But we need to be sure our players will be ready to support us during development.

Let's have a talk.
[h1]Battlecruiser Games[/h1]

Hello there,

It were a long time since the last update, so we added more new maps as usual.

First of all, we added Challenge mode of Climbing missions where you stand against human units. They have PvP abilities, so it's kinda new experience.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/116_2.jpg]

Secondly, we added 2 new co-op missions, Canyon and Olimp. The first onee has a large road (like in Old School Map). Also, the game mechanics of the level is different. There is a lot of troll units but they don't take lives, but human units take. You can't kill all of them, so you need to find a way to kill all human. Pretty funny map.

Thirdly, Olimp is the biggest map in the game. There are 3 roads where enemies come from. Each road has unique setup of units. Also, there is Ice Crystal from Valley missions. The mission is very hard, but we think veterans will like it very much.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/116_top.jpg]

We fixed an issue with no getting Glory and PvP points. So, now you should be able to get all maps from Hot Air Balloon. Also, we fixed a bug when some players could play only story mode of new co-op maps. 

We made some changes in the rating. It didn't score result of co-op battles We recalculated score of all players. It should show proper data now. We are going to fix all issues with the rating in the next update.

The good news for owners of 4k monitors. The size of text bubbles is increasing depend on Screen resolution.

[h1]DLC news[/h1]

We were working on our next game all previous month. We are going to release the game in EA state in October and after that uploading DLC for Warstone. As we we said earlier, 80% of art for DLC is ready. All missions and new units are drawn. There is a screenshot of one.
