In this update we added new co-op map, Climbing. It's a beatiful map with unusual enemies. There comes human units as enemies. They are much tougher then trolls units and have special abilities. If you played PvP, you know, there are much interesting abilities.

Also, we added Survival mode for Pursuit mission.

[h1]Game changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Number of attacking rows in PvP was increased from 25 to 50
    [*]Starting gold for Challenge, Survival mode of Pursuit mission was reduced
    [*]Health of enemies in Climbing mission was increased by 2.5x times
    [*]Range of Novices is slightly increase. Range of Sorcerer is the same as range of Novices now.  
[*]Damage of Sorcerer was reduced by 1-2. Cooldown of bless ability was increased from 25/15s to 35/21s  
[*]Range of attack for Tier 3,4 melee units was slightly increased. Attack damage of Tier 3 melee units was increased. 
[*]Witchers and Inquisitors has slightly higher attack rate.  
[/list]
[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/115.jpg]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
We fixed a lot of bugs. There is a changelog:
[list]
    [*]Fixed the problem in co-op games when the game got stuck after win/lose
    [*]Fixed the bug in co-op games when joined player got wrong spells
    [*]Fixed the bug with Spirit of the Stone spell
 [*]Fixed the bug with items when a player couldn't use them
[*]A list of enemies in new wave now works properly
 [*]Recalling units with Treasurer skill now gives right amount of gold
[*]Fixed the bug when a player couldn't see selection of unit/tower in 6 maps
 [*]Encyclopedia now works fine
 [*]Sale skill no more reduces price in the city market
 [*]Fixed the bug when a player couldn't use stronger rune until he take it out/in
 [*]Arena 1 and Arena 2 has the same position in the city now
 [*]Fixed the bug when a player instantly completed Star Hunter quest even the requirements wasn't done
 [*]Fixed the bug when a player couldn't transform the stone in The Death Road mission
 [*]Visual improvements of Meteor Spell
 [*]Added missing icon for Doombringer
 [*]Fixed the bug when 1 placed stone removed all grass in The Ordeal mission
 [*]Some UI improvements
[/list]
[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.15 version[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1727575977598583444/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.

[h1]Second chapter and new upcoming game[/h1]

The second chapter is 70% done. It has 15 new missions with new enemies and 14 new tower units. SP pool will be increased to 125 points. Plus a lot of another good stuff. 

But firstly we need to fix all remaining bugs. We brought the game to stable version, there are no critical bugs now. But some things are waiting to be polished. 

While Game Designer and Programmer do this stuff, our Artist is working on new game.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/AoD/Aod_1.jpg]

It is a TD game too, but with funny story and setting. There you can see a sketch of opening cinematic. We are going to release the game in EA state in September/October. Support us with your feedback and any ideas.

Add the game to wishlist to read news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/603320/Age_of_Defense/
[h1]A note from Developers[/h1]

We worked non-stop for 3 years to bring our dream, Warstone alive. We are really happy you like it. So, we achieved our goal and need to take small vacation. We will monitoring forums and answer all questions, but there will be no new content/maps in the next 2 weeks. Thanks for your understanding.

Play with us,
[h1]Battlecruiser Games[/h1]
[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/wstd_crus_logo.jpg]

notes.title: Major update. Version 1.14 is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/55ad40c34fb2df183de88646ea3764d49715c04e.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

That was a tough month after the release of the game. There were so much new players. But we could handle it. Thanks to everyone for your patience.
We reworked the server. Now it works stable for more than 3 weeks. So, if you had troubles with it at the release dates, you should try the game now. You will have better experience. We promise.

We are working on offline mode. The game is half offline now. The battle plays on your side with local server. So, there shouldn't be any delays. We added a reconnection system, so even if you lose connection to the server, it will reconnect and you can finish the battle. Only the city works on the server side now. We need more time, then we expected to move it to full offline.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/114_old.jpg]

[h1]Artbook and Bundle[/h1]
We added 5 new languages to Artbook DLC. It has 30 unquie slides, 70 comics and 15 game tracks. The main feature of the artbook is the secret level. We found an old level models and some old enemy models. We created a mission with unique TD mechanics with 50 waves. I think, a lot of playets might find it as interesting. 

Also, this mission gives up to 400 mithril reward for a completion and.... it has repetitive mithril reward. It is the only mission in the game with it.

We and especially our Artist put a lot of efforts to this Artbook, so if you like it, please, leave a small review in Steam.

I remind, you can find a way to unlock this mission in the Artbook.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/768240/Warstone_OST_Artbook_and_Comics/

Also, we created a bundle which contains Warstone TD, Artbook DLC and our first game, Guards. You can take it with 15% discount [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7361/The_Mithril_Box/e]here[/url]!

[h1]New in this update[/h1]
First of all, we added Challenge mode for Pursuit map. It's an unique co-op mission, all enemies have 5x health. So, this mission is really tough. Requires a lot of strategical decisions from high level mates. Enjoy!

Also, we add 1 UI feature. Now you can point at the next wave button and see which enemies come in the next wave.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
We fixed a lot of bugs. There is a changelog:

[list]
[*]Fixed the bug when producing buildings didn't give resources
[*] You get currencies for the Hot Air Balloon now
    [*]There are no more empty stones with casting Spirit of the Stone ability
    [*]Enemies don't get stuck in the road now on usual maps
    [*]Fixed the bug when an enemy with reincarnation ability killed with transmutation got stuck
[*] Now you get right amount of gold with transmutation skill
    [*]Fixed the bug when Thunderstorm visual effect disappeared earlier with +35% special item
    [*]Health of summoned monsters now depends on difficulty.  
    [*]Fixed the bug when enemies with reincarnation ability gave reward 2 times
  [*]Fixed Marauder skill. It gives potions on level 1 and coins/mana on level 2
    [*]Titan's Fist is now Earth magic
    [*]Fixed the bug with unability to summon tower with Credit and Treasurer skill
    [*]Gold spells now can be used with negative gold
    [*]Fixed wrong entry/exit pictures in the Valley Survival
    [*]Fixed the bug when some sounds were playing even if music is turned off
 [*]Fixed the bug when some sounds were playing even after the mission is finished
 [*]Volume of Battlecruiser logo was lowered
 [*]Fixed the bug with wrong "c" letter in description of scrolls
 [*]Texture of flying skull (Necro ability) is right now
 [*]Fixed the bug with delayed sound of falling meteor
 [*]Fixed visuals bugs with casting of Rend and Silence spells
 [*]Now you can take resources in the city without necessity of restarting the game
 [*]The height of stones in the Collaboration was increased (they were in the ground)
 [*]OK button in the dialogues with the old mage got bigger
 [*]Fixed the ability to cheat in the game
 [*]Fixed some errors in multiplayer missions when the game shut down right after the start.
[/list]

[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.14 version[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1727575977575759209/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.

Play with us,

notes.title: Server Update! #3
notes.content:
Hello there,

We maintain two servers now. One for Asia and one for other world. We uploaded new server code to other world server. We need your feedback. Does it work better or worse? Was amount of disconnects reduced after this update?

New server creates small mini-servers for each player. Disconnect of one user does not affect other players. 

If everything goes well, we will merger servers and will start working on the next update. Help us with feedback!

UPD #1 The problem with getting disconnected after playing Co-op and PvP was fixed.

UPD #2 (Version 1.13.4)
- Some hotfixes which should prevent from being disconnected after win/lose at co-op games
- Fixed the problem when players couldnt create survival and challenges modes of co-op missions
- Fixed the problem, when class and score weren't shown in arena

UPD #3 (Version 1.13.6)
- Added an ability to reconnect to the game. It should prevent problems, when the player got disconnected after win/lose of a mission
- Rewards from mission increased. Added Mithril rewards to story missions

Please tell us if the problems with disconnects disappeared!
Stay with us,
[h1]Battlecruiser Games[/h1]

Hello dear players,

It was hard days after the release of Warstone. We didn't expect so much attention to our small game. We are really happy you play our game.

We had some troubles with the server, mostly in Asia region. We have made some hot fixes, so the server works stable now.

Play with us,

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.13! + Patch #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/03d6e465bebec698f998561b2be9f9a668022d13.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

Looks like we finished the work on improvement of server code. Now, if even an error occurs in the server code, only 1 battle will be closed and other players will continue the game. Hope, it will help.

Also, if you get disconnected, you don't need to relaunch the game now. You just need to push Play button again. Saves a lot of time now!

[h1]Game changes[/h1]

We reviewed all game. We played from the beginning as a new player and completed all 33 missions. So there are some changes.

[list]
    [*]Wood mission rewards were slightly reduced. Iron and Mana rewards were highly increased. Also, we added mithril rewards to 10 story missions.
    [*]Ordeal, The Dark Forest, The Crossroads, On the March, Fight to the Death, The Valley, The Heart of Corruption, The Final, Piedmont became much more easier.
    [*]Night Hunt, The Forest of Amazons, The Dvarven Shooting Range, At a Rest Stop, The Death road became easier.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
We increased damage of melee units to bring them back to the table

Knight base damage increased from 20-29 to 23-31
Templar Knight Base damage increased from 32-44 to 36-50
Witcher base damage increased from 11-16 to 13-17
Inquisitor base damage increased from 19-23 to 22-26
Base attack time of Sorcerer reduced from 2.2 to 2.3 seconds

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/113_2.jpg]

[h1]Skill changes[/h1]
We made several changes in the skills. We increased efficiency of Warlord and also improved not popular skills.
We reseted skills for all players.

[b]Warlord[/b]
[list]
    [*]Double Time skill. Bonus changed from -20/-40/-60% to -22/-44/-66%
    [*]Portal skill changed from 40/70/100% for 2/2/2 SP to 50/75/100% for 2/1/1 SP
    [*]Stone aura. Attack bonus increased from 20% to 25%. Damage bonus increased from 33% to 40%. Duration of spell increased from 30s to 35s. Area of effect increased from 350 to 400. Manacost reduced from 15/20 to 10/15.
 [*]Reload Drills bonus increased from 10%/20%/30% to 11%/22%/33%
 [*]Brute Force bonus increased from 15%/30%/45% to 20%/40%/60%
 [*]Accuracy bonus increased from 12%/24%/36% to 15%/30%/45%
 [*]Warcraft damage bonus changed from 10% to 15%. Amount of kills changed from 12/7/3 to 18/9/2
 [*]Warcraft II damage bonus changed from 25% to 30%. Amount of kills changed from 20/12/5 to 25/16/7. SP cost changed from 2/2/2 to 2/1/1
 [*]Warcraft III. Amount of kills changed from 30/19/10 to 30/20/9. SP cost changed from 2/2/2 to 2/1/1
 [*]Slowing stones SP cost changed from 2/2/2 to 2/1/1
 [*]Morale SP cost changed from 2/1/2 to 2/1/. Mana bonus changed from 3/5/10 to 4/7/10
 [*]Conscription damage bonus changed from 1/2/3 to 1/2/4
 [*]Archery damage bonus changed from 1/2/3 to 1/2/4
 [*]Berzerk. Amount of attack increased on all levels increased by 1. Cooldown reduced from 15s to 12s
 [*]Summoning Fury damage bonus increased from 25%/50%/75% to 33%/66%/100%
 [*]Warlord bonus damage increased from 12%/24%/36% to 13%/26%/40%
 [*]Hammer of Gods ability damage increased from 55 to 60.
 [*]Lightning Sword cast time reduced. Ability cooldown reduced from 30s to 25s.
 [*]Death Strike gold cost reduced from 75 to 65. DPS reduced from 30 to 25
 [*]Magical Chakram gold cost reduced from 100 to 90
 [*]Spirit of the Stone. There are no more stones with no spirit.
 [*]Stone Explosion damage increased from 150/175/225 to 175/225/350
[/list]
[b]Sorcerer[/b]
[list]
    [*]Lightning damage increased from 70/90/115/145 to 100/135/175/225
    [*]Mana Reserver lvl 3 lowered from 200% to 175%
    [*]Potency time bonus increased from 20%/40%/60% to 22%/44%/66%
    [*]Power Surge bonus increased from 3/5/10 to 3/6/12
 [*]Static Charge damage increased from 6/12/20 to 7/15/25
 [*]Double shot time improved from 18/12/7 to 17/11/6
 [*]Thunderstorm cooldown reduced from 150/120 to 125/100 seconds
 [*]Storm duration reduced from 12/18 to 10/15 seconds. Slow amount reduced from 40%/60% to 33%/50%
 [*]Electric beetle cooldown on level 3 reduced from 50s to 40s
 [*]Firewall damage increased from 30/50 to 35/55. Cooldown reduced from 90s to 80s
 [*]Faerie Fire cooldown increased from 30/24 to 45/36
 [*]Meteor Shower damage changed from 80 to 100. Burn DPS damage increased from 3 to 4. Cooldown reduced from 180/135s to 150/112s
 [*]Sorcerer range bonus changed from 10/20/40% to 10/27/45%
 [*]Miniaturize area on level 3 slightly reduced
 [*]Teleport cooldown reduced from 15/3 to 10/2. Range of teleport increased by 20%
 [*]Sorcerer magic power bonus increased from 16%/32%/48% to 18%/36%/55%
 [*]Fireball bonus damage increased from 50/75 to 55/80
 [*]War Fire Bonus damage increased from 30%/60%/100% to 40%/80%/125%
 [*]Carry over changed from 5/7/10 mana bonus and 30/40/50% chance to 5/10/15 mana bonus with 30/35/40% chance
 [*]Ancestors spirit bonus damage changed from 30/45 to 33/50%
 [*]Owl's Wisdom manacost changed from 75/55 to 70/45. Owl stone no give 1x mana bonus instead of 2x. 
[/list]
[b]Treasurer[/b]
[list]
    [*]Contract time changed from +200/400/700% to +400/950/1400%
    [*]Looter Level 1 now gives potions and Level 2 gives gold/mana. Drop chance increased to 5%
    [*]Bomb damage changed from 75/95/150 to 100/125/200
    [*]Power Surge bonus increased from 3/5/10 to 3/6/12
 [*]Shop refreshing time decreased from 120/75/30 to 90/50/25
 [*]Gold Rush duration increased from 7.5/10s to 9/12s
 [*]Benefit bonus changed from 10/20/30% to 11/22/33%
[/list]
[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/113_1.jpg]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Survival mode of Old School Map now works fine
[*]Fixed the bug when mithril upgrades didn't work
[*]Fixed the bug when player got permament message "Ally left the game"
[*] Now if player left a mission in co-op, other player will see it.
 [*]Fixed the bug when players didn't get rewards for PvP and Co-op missions
 [*]Health of summoned monsters now depends on difficulty.
 [*]Added 1 missing comics in russian
 [*]Armored wolfs in 21 wave of Survival mode of Old School mode now can be attacked from all sources
 [*]Enemy no more can take gold coins and mana potions of other player in PvP
    [*]Fixed the bug when new scenario stone destroyed only 1 stone and left others.
    [*]Fixed the bug when Titan's Fist didn't damage already stunned enemy
    [*]Added missing sound to the shoots of Elementals
    [*]Fixed regeneration animation of Ogres
 [*]Added missing title to Fireball spell
 [*]Fixed visual bugs on The Cliff  and Armory missions
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes of Patch #2[/h1]
[list]
- Now Attackers updrade are shown in the workshop by default
- Now you can't skip important dialogues with the old mage. We made it because some players got conused of dialogue mechanics
- Now you can't no click build button for the Workshop.
- Small UI improvements for Chinese
- The font for tips was improved
[/list]

[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.13 version[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1693795812298630113/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.
Play with us,
[h1]Battlecruiser Games[/h1]

notes.title: Server Update!
notes.content:
Hello there,

We made a huge updated in the server code. If something goes wrong now, only 1 player (who triggered a mistake) will be disconnected, but all other players will continue the game ( the server will be working).

We hope it will work fine, but there could be errors.
Let's us know, if something gone wrong with the game after this update (disconnects, lags, delays and etc)

P.s. The game might work unstable in 1-2 hours due hotfixes. Thx for understanding.

Stay with us,

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.10 is here! 33% OFF
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/ef8d1e111cd3d5cd50a873f1773e1c6b8838e881.jpg[/img]

[h1]To new players[/h1]

Hello there,

It was a year since we released Warstone in Early Access in Steam. Finally, we finished almost all preparations for a full release. We are going to release the game in May. Current discount with 33% off is the last before release.
The game won't significantly change before release. We are just going to polish it and fix bugs. So, it's the last time when can buy the game with lower price. Enjoy!

[h1]Update info[/h1]

In this update we completely remade sound system. First of all, we fixed bugs when some sounds didn't sound.Secondly, we add 2-3 alternatives for all attack,hit and death sound. It should add more reality to the game. Thirdly, we added all missing sounds for abilities, magics, city buildings and etc. We added 131 sounds in total. We made a lot of sounds updates , but anyway some sounds could be missing or don't fit. We really need your feedback about new sounds.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/110_1.jpg]

We finally added Polish localisation. Big thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/tschilumbu/]Andrzej[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198118351386/]Jakub[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198393593777/]Marcin[/url] and 
 [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198060595058/]Rafal[/url]. 

And we added Survival mode of Old School Map. It has 100 waves. We were busy with other things, so the map could be a little unbalanced. Tell us if it OK or no. Go for last 99th star.

There is a minor bonus. Now if a player hosted a game and other player joined it, then arena sound will play.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Price of all buildings has been reduced by 40-75%. it should prevent players from being stuck because of a lack of resources.
    [*]Difficulties no more affect on missions rewards. All rewards are set to 150% of base value (same as playing on Hard)
[*]Now the player getes gold back if tower was killed by scenario stone
    [*]Cooldown of Crystal wave on Valley mission has been increased from 60 to 75 seconds. Duration of freezing has been decreased from 90 to 70 seconds.
[*]Starting gold on Valley missions has been increased by 50
[*]Starting gold on Survival of Night Hunt mission has been increased by 250
[/list]

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/110_2.jpg]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Unstable Internet connection option now works on Mac
    [*]Imrovements of German localisation
    [*]Ui improvements of market menu
    [*]Visual fixes of Transmutation spell
    [*]Fixed the bug with wrong display of attack radius for tower on Eagle warstone.
    [*]Improved enemy paths on Valley mission.
    [*]Fixed wrong number of upgrades in workshop menu
    [*]Fixed visual bugs at Crossroads, Going for Mithril and fight to the Death missions
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes of Patch #1[/h1]
[list]
[*]Volume of sounds was normalized
    [*]Added missing sounds city/23_baloon, skin_avatar_hit, mini_element_hit
greathallwhat1, shaman_sleep, slowing_stone.
    [*]Fixed problem with Polish
    [*]Added improvements of German localisation
[*]Survival mode of Old School mode is now available
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes of Patch #2[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rune of Time (reset of progress) now works fine
[*]Sell price in the marker increased from 25% to 50% for gold items and to 75% for mithril items.
[*]Added missing sounds shaman_blue_magic_upd and killer_magic_chakram_damage
[/list]

[h1]Changes of Patch #3[/h1]
[list]
[*]Achievement of Survival of Old School map has been changed
[*]Added missing sounds leader_attack_v2, none and eagle_death
[*]Ally's warstones are now darker
[*]The cursor of placing stone no more red after destroying a stone with Stone explosion spell
[*]Fixed the bug on The Dark Forest mission when new scenario stone destroyed a current stone
[*]Fixed the bug when a player could increase attack wave by changing attack order
[*]Battle meditation ability visual fixes
[*]UI improvements
[/list]


[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.10 version[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1696044439575588440/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.
Play with us,

We added new mission Pursuit to Hot Air Ballon. It's a co-op mission with increased health of monsters. Usual Boar on Nightmare has 112 health. It's a quite tough challenge. Enjoy!

We also made several improvements in "Unstable Internet connection" option which should remove disconnects. It should fixed the problem with disconnects after long AFK as well. Also we returned Restart button.

    [*]Now if you have not enough gold for casting gold spell you will receive proper message!

    [*]Cost of SuberUberMega upgrades is now calculated properly if the unit had gold abilities of Warlord.
[*]Fixed some bugs with Bane
    [*]Fixed the bug with endless astral animation
    [*]Fixed attack animation of Bombardier
[*]Teleportation spell no more works on opponent units.
    [*]Fixed the visual effect of Ghosts

[*]Added Ninja icon in PvP upgrades

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.06 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/bcda0fc5fcd242dd45d92347d8be4e958efd076a.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

There is a lot of changes in the game. First of all, we added first new language, French. Congrats us. There are 7 more to come. We are going to put them all in the game before full release.

Secondly, we remade UI a little. We added special effect for pointing and remade effect for choosing. We added new animated effect for casting magic. We remodeled health bars, they appear now only if enemy doesn't have full HP. We also changed font for red text of misses and critical strikes. Also, own, allied and enemy forces now has different colors for pointing and choosing. We hope, these changes make the game more pleasant to play!

We are preparing the game for release, so there is only one map in this update, Challenge mode of Round Dances.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/106.jpg]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Drop Chance of Marauder skill increased from 3% to 4%
 [*]Added comics for Workshop, Architect, Town Hall, Magic Academy menus when there are not options to buy/research.
[*]Added hotkey in the menu for Call wave
[*]Cost of SuberUberMega upgrades was slightly increased to make it less imbalanced for non Treasurer classes. Also fixed the bug with wrong cost display
[*]Added animation for stone summoning
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
We fixed a lot of bugs. There is the changelog:
[list]
    [*]Corrosive Shells ability affects enemies which was damage by splash now.
    [*]Fixed the bug when it was possible to learn several skills without fulfill conditions (for example Warlord skill).
[*]Treasurer skill now works properly
[*]Fixed the bug when player could upgrade stones under the unit with Spirit of the Stone spell
[*]Artifacts for thunderstorm now works properly
      [*]Bosses are no more targetable by Transmutation spell
    [*]Water magic now improves Ancestors Spirits spell
[*]Animation of recharging of spells was fixed
[*]Fixed wrong filling of the wave timer
[*]Fixed the bug with wrong tool tips in Skill Menu
   [*] Fixed the bug when Armor Aura decreased armor
[*]Fixed the bug when auras could stop working
[*]Perfect Gem now shows right attack speed
[*]Game doesn't breaks pause in restart confirmation window.
[*]Town Hall no more overlaps Dialogue boxes
[*]Fixed the bug with effect of gold gaining from clicking early wave button
[*]Fixed counter of achievement when the player was playing with Unstable Internet connection option
[*]Troll Blademaster is now vulnerable to magic while invising
[*]Fixed the bug when Razorbacks got accelerated when they were leaving Storm area
[*]Fixed animation of Stone Fist
[*]Fixed the situation when the player could leak Shaman on The Battle on The Meadow mission and then got stuck
    [*]Now if he player tries to summon Warstone of Tiger with Level of 1 skill he get error message with proper text
[*]Fixed the bug when Warstones of Owl appeared on Survival mode of The Death Road mission.

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.05 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/e774e918ba94f71acc0a7e666589ebc3b3f610b8.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

First of all we added console command Hell x. We made it for experienced players. Type this in chat before starting the game and enemies will have more health (Hell 200 means their health will be doubled). It works on all maps

Secondly, we have got a lot of complains about grind. When we designed the game we didn't want force players to grind. Since release in April we added a lot of ways to get extra resources. It wasn't enough. So in this update we made dramatics changes in economy part
[list]
    [*]Gathering buildings now gives resources  for certain amount of battle time now. For example, you get wood every 1 hour in battle, iron for every 75 minutes, mithril every 3 hours. So, you don't need to login every day to collect resources. Just play missions and get extra resources income
    [*]Total wood cost of all upgrades was reduced by 50%. Total cost of mithril upgrades was reduced by 55%. Total cost of spell upgrades in Magic Academy was reduced by 45%. Total cost of PvP upgrades was reduced by 75%
    [*]We dramatically (by 100-150% increased wood rewards per campaign missions and for 50% for Challenge and Survival modes.
[/list]

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/105round.jpg]

Now when you finish the last campaign missions you can research 70% of all upgrades. It was about 30% in previous versions of the game. So, we hope, it   bring more pleasure for new players. Say NO to grind now!

In this patch we added Challenge mode for Old School Map. It has 70 pretty hard waves. The last boss has 80000 hp on normal. Yeah, you hear right. Eighty thousands of HP. Enjoy!

Also we added new Co-op mission which is available for purchasing in Hot Air Balloon. It has 2 rounds paths and bring new experience to the game. We hope you will like it.

Stone of Eagle now gives 45% range bonus (was 30%). Stone of Tiger gives 35% damage bonus (was 30%). We also increased time before first wave in PvP missions by 10 seconds.

Finally, we added 2 new soundtracks.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/105old.jpg]

We fixed a lot of bugs. There is a changelog:
[list]
    [*]Fixed the bug when teleportation skill of Nechai didn't slow enemies
    [*]Fixed the bug when Curse ability of Necro added damage instead of reducing it
    [*]Challenge mode of At a Rest Stop mission now works fine
 [*]Fixed the bug when the game got disconnected after pressing Esc if the player played with Unstable Internet connection setting
 [*]Fixed the bug when player could get wrong achievement count in the battle
 [*] Fixed the bug when bosses could be targetted with Transmutation skill in Old School Map
[*]Bonus Attack speed from using Berzerk spell now applies instantly
 [*]Enemies no more gets bonuses from Valkyrie' abilities
    [*]Fixed he bug when some Razorbacks wasn't count for achievement.
    [*]Fixed the bug in PvP missions when players could call new wave with Space button even if a wave in the progress. 
 [*]Final Strike Ability of Assassins no more hit Blade Masters in invisibility
    [*]Fixed the bug with jumping icon of Transmutation spell
    [*]Clickable boxes in settings menu now works properly
 [*]Fixed the missing texture of big stones in Old School Map
    [*] A lot of UI improvements
    [*]Fixed some bugs when red errors appeared after speaking with the old mage.
 [*]All scrolls now have 10 seconds cooldown.
       [*]Enemy/ally stones in multiplayer game are darker. Adds more understanding to the game.
 [*]The exclamation point dialog now always beyond  "..." flavor dialog.
    [*]Fixed the bug when player could get 2 New Level windows during playing in Auto City mode
[/list]

[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.05 version[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1693785669864322106/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.
Play with us,

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.04 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/5a159e150b04cb54e9231cc91cd85cc6e22b629d.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

This December was really hard. Our programmer was sick all month. This is the second update in this month. It contains not so much stuff. But we tried to do our best.

First of all we added new co-op mission, Old School Map. It contains 40 simple waves and should remind you how first TD games looks like. There is only story mode for now. We will add challenge and survival mode in future patch. The last one will contain 100 waves. Let's see if you like it
If it is interesting, we will add  - we will add more similar maps in future.

We finally fixed campaign rating. Wow, there are so many players who passed all 96 missions on Gold Start. We really appreciate you like the game.

We made several changes in skill system. We hope it will make all classes more competitive.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[b]Warlord[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.03 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/cad9c2ec86405dc431bd497bb1c4bce77fe10251.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

This day came. [u]All 96 missions in the game now[/u]. It means we added last survival missions for On the March, Valley, Magic Gem, Spirits' Gorge,The Final missions.

We added [b]Alternative Server[/b] setting. It should dramatically reduce lags, delays, disconnects for players who had them. Go the setting and turn this option on. We really need your feedback if it makes your game smoother.This option works only for Windows users for now. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/e93b32a4735a489f4de5e2f8370014da15c7afcf.jpg[/img]

We increased maximum level to 60. Extra 6 Skill points are available for you now.

We have finally added an ability to [u]manually resetting your progress[/u]. You don't need to ask for that in the forum. Rune of Restart appears near the Old Mage. It can resets your game progress.

Some people asked about [u]customizable hotkeys[/u]. Here they are. You can now set any hotkeys for spells, game speed, start new wave buttons.

Wwe added [u]5 new artifacts[/u]. A lot of people complained about a lack of wood, so we decided to add 3 items which increases wood reward up to +100%. We also noticed that Titan's Fist got pretty useless in the game, so we added 2 artifacts which adds area of effect for this spell. With artifact it becomes powerful disable spell with area 6 second stun.

Finally, we changed [u]parameters of difficulties[/u].[list]
[*][b]Easy.[/b] Enemies has 75% health (was 80%) and has reduced armor and magic resistance by 50%
[*][b]Normal.[/b] No changes
[*][b]Hard.[/b] Bonus health was increased from 25% to 33%
[*][b]Nightmare.[/b] Bonus magic resistance was reduced from 35% to 20%. Enemies now have +50% armor or at least 1 bonus armor.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/34bcf91a10209ea79e8f0b6a62c003436feff89f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed the bug when the player sometimes couldn't login in the game (the problem with options.txt)
[*]Fixed the bug when resseted player has got extra 80 points in campaign rating
[*]Fixed the bug with invulnerable enemies with 0 Health at the survival mode of The Horrors of Dark Forest mission
[*]Should be fixed stuck enemies on several maps[/list]

[h1]Patch #1[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Fixed some errors in 1.03 when players couldn't login in the game
[*]Survival mode of On the March mission is now available
[*]Magic Gem and The Horrors of The Dark Forest are now co-op missions again
[*]Fixed the bug when Boomba and Crystal didn't use abilities
[*]Fixed some red errors in Survival mode of On the March
[*]Mithril Axe now works properly
[*]Fixed red errors after using new items which improves Titan's Fist
[*]Fixed %cnt symbols from mission previews
[*]Fixed prices of Treasurer in-battle market.[/list]

[b]Mission Changes. Survival.[/b][list]
[*]The Final. Bounty from enemies is reduced by 50% gold.
[*]Magic Gem. Bonus Regeneration increased from +5 to +15. Gem heals 2x more health now.
[*]Valley. Crystal now freezes units. Bomber is invulnerable now.
[*]Spirits' Gorge. Health of monsters increased by 100%[/list]

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/103.jpg]

[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.02 version[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/2906376154326028000/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.

Play with us,
[h1]Battlecruiser Games[/h1]

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.02 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/7ba90d1d6f6e824ab3bdb1804b48b64a41bff2c1.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

In this update we added 5 new survival missions, The Heart of Corruption, Fight to the Death, Piedmont, The Horrors of the Dark Forest. The new co-op mission is really tough, because enemies has double health. Actually, they are all a little bit harder than previous similar stages. So, you aware now :D

[h1]Game balance changes[/h1][list]
    [*]Reload time of Elementals was decreased from 5 to 4.75. Attack range was increased by 25. Attack damage was increased from 35-45 to 35-55 for Spirit Elementals and from 65-105 to 65-115 for Warrior Elementals. They also can target astral units now (Ghost, Bane, Phantom). We hope these changes will make them more popular.  
    [*]Faerie Fire skill ability now affects on the area. The bonus damage was increased from 40% / 75% to 45% / 70% / 100%
    [*]SuberUberMega was improved. Level 1. Bonus of reload item was increased from 0.75 to 0.7 Level 2. Bonus damage was increased from 45% to 50%. Level 3. Damage from 60% to 75%. Reload from 0.6 to 0.5
    [*]Base attack damage of Assassins was increased from 11-13 to 12-15 and Ninja's from 16-19 to 17-21
    [*]The final cost of Bombardiers was increased from 60 to 75. Base damage was increased from 18-25 to 19-28. Throw grenade radius ability was reduced by 20%
    [*]Base damage of novices was increased from 7-11 to 9-11. Magic projectile now moves 33% faster 
    [*]Witcher's base damage was increased from 11-14 to 11-16
    [*]Amazon's base damage was increased from 4-7 to 5-7
    [*]Reload time of Sputnik (Warrior Elemental ability) was reduced from 1.75 to 1.5
    [*]Radius of blessing ability was reduced by 25%. Final cooldown was increased from 15 to 20 seconds
    [*]Valkyrie's Warcray ability radius was reduced by 20%[/list]

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/102.jpg]

We have finally added new artifacts. There 24 of them. We have also changed parameters of most items. We have also decreased prices of low level items and increased required level for better items. Player could unlock all items in 15 level, now a player need 25-33 level to unlock the best items. There is a changelog for all items.

[h1]New items[/h1][list]
    [*]Gunpowder Box / Gunpowder Barrel.. Damage of Bomb spell increases by 50% / 100%
    [*]Gem / Flawless Gem / Perfect Gem. Time between attacks of Novices and Priestesses decreases by 10% / 20% / 30%
    [*]Bandage / Assassin Bandage / Ninja Bandage. Damage of Assassins and Ninja increases by 2 / 4 / 7
    [*]Feather / Feathery Amulet / Feathery Bracelet. Summoning cost of Shieldmaidens and Valkyries decreases by 8 / 16 / 25 gold
    [*]Burning Meteor / Meteor Staff. Manacost of Meteor Shower spell decreases by 15 / 30
    [*]Cube / Hybercube / Elemntal Cube. Time between attacks of Spirit Elementals and Warrior Elementals decreases by 10% / 20% / 30%
    [*]Thunder Crystal / Thunder Staff. Duration of Thunderstorm spell increases by 35% / 75%
    [*]Ruby / Royal Ruby. Cooldown of Transmormation spell decreases by 30% / 60%
    [*]Spirit Bone / Spirit Staff. Area of effect of Ancestor Help spell increases by 35% / 75%
[/list]
[h1]Old items[/h1][list]
   [*]Lightning Glove / Lightning Staff now decreases manacost of Lightning spell by 3 / 6
   [*]Purse / Gold Purse. Now gives 1 / 2 gold per 10 / 9 seconds
   [*]Sword / Magicked Sword / Mithril Sword now gives 3 / 6 / 9 damage instead of 2 / 4 / 7
   [*]Cudgel / Magicked Cudgel / Mithril damage now gives 4 / 9 / 14 damage instead of 4 / 8 /13
   [*]Captain's Horn / Commander's Horn now decreases cooldown by 35% / 65% (was 25% / 50%)
   [*]Bronze Ring / Silver Ring / Golden Ring now gives 15 / 30 / 50 gold instead of 10 / 25 / 45
   [*]Elemental books now gives bonus 30% / 60% magic power instead of  20% / 40%
   [*]Fire Glove / Fire Staff now gives 50% / 100% bonus damage instead of 25% / 50%
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/a460e2f7ea816294783b40636240ebdac35c801e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed pink missions on Mac
[*]Fixed a bug when a player couldn't move camera on certain missions
[*]Fixed the bug with SuberUberMega
[*]Fixed the bug with red errors when a player couldn't open settings menu in the main menu
[*]Fixed the bug with consumable artifacts
[*]Mana skill Lvl 3 gives proper 100 mana (was 40)
[*]Fixed shown range with range affected artifacts
[*]Map specials on Magic Gem and The Horrors of the Dark Forest works properly now
[*]3 unavailable buildings was removed from the architect menu
[*]Fixed visual bugs on  On the March mission on Mac
[*]Market updates now every 12 hours
[*]Shaman stand animation was fixed
[*]Fixed shown range with range affected artifacts
[/list]

[h1]Bug and discussion thread for 1.02 version[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1489992713688360117/

Support us with a Steam Review if you like Warstone.

Play with us,
[h1]Battlecruiser Games[/h1]

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.01 Beta is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/4de3a53ce45f3efcf22893836259c2f73fb6017a.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

This update is not so big as the previous one. But it contains some new cool features. First of all, we have got a lot of feedback from players who like TD gameplay but don't like city part with the story, quests and etc. So we announce new option for these players, Auto City Mode. All quests, buildings, dialogues are completing automatically, so a player can play one battle after another. No clicks in the city. Pure TD. You can enable/disable it at any time in the menu.

We added 5 new survival modes for The Ordeal, At a Rest Stop, The Death Road,  The Dark Forest, The Horrors of the Dark Forest missions. The last one is really tough, but a reward is valuable, 100 mithril. UPD. We blocked this mission for a while. Looks like it's broken. It will be available in a couple of days.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/Autocity.jpg]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
We have also made some improvements in the UI and some skills
[list]
[*]To make Auto City mode more comfortable we significantly decreased price of high level building like Crystal of Elements, The Order, Bastion and etc. So any player could build them right after they appear. We also increased rewards from campaign missions.
[*]Units are summoned instantly before first wave starts
[*]A notification window about new upgrades, spells now appears in the left corner with a small bar.
[*]Improved double click in the Skill of Tree
[*]Added a notification in the battle if server shut down. We hope you won't see this window :D

[*]Life time of summoning troll (Marauder skill) was increased from 40 to 120 seconds
[*]Slow stones skill was reworked. It affects 3/5/7 stones instead 2/3/4. Cooldown was reduced from 60 to 45 seconds
[/list]

Finally, some people blamed us for Nechai missions and asked to cut them. We won't cut them, because they make the gamapley more diverse. But we tryed to do our best to make these missions more fun.

[h1]Nechai in Campaign mode[/h1]
[list][*]Damage has been increased from 10-14 to 12-15
[*]Glaive throw damage has been increased from 50 to 85
[*]Dissecting Blow damage has been increased from 25 to 40 and area by 20%
[*]Rage duration has been increased by 20%
[*]Maximum damage bonus from killing enemies has been increased from 15 to 35.[/list]

[h1]Nechai in Challenge and Survival modes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage is 19-27
[*]Glaive Throw deals 145 damage. It also slows enemy by 50%.
[*]Dissecting Blow damage deals 60 damage. It also decreases enemy armor by 5.
[*]Rage. It gives 17% chance to do 300% damage
[*]Teleport. It slows all enemies by 33% in the place where Nechai appears.[/list]
SuperuberMega upgrade also work on Nechai now, so you can make SuberUberNechai who could perform 500 damage attacks now :D
Actually, it cost 0 gold now. It will cost 500 in the next patch. Hurry up! :D
We hope you will like Nechai missions now.

[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/Nechai.jpg]

[list]
[*]Fixed the bug with teleportation of enemy units in PvP
[*]Fixed the bug with Spirit of the Stone spell
[*] Fixed the bug with negative damage bonus with Money Power skill
[*]Added missing icon for Pupils Staff
[*] Enemy armor is reduced now under Corrosive Shells effect
[*]Added Second Life mithril upgrades for player who doesn't have it
[*]Burning now lasts properly for Level 2 of Fireball Spell and Meteor Shower
[*] Hell Roar of Hell Boars now works properly
[*]Fixed the bug when a player couldn't recall no more units if a unit was killed during the process
[*]Fixed the bug when a player could start a wave by pressing Space and break the game before clicking on Start the battle
[*]Fixed the bug when Recall button could disappear in the summoning menu
[*]Removed spikes during researching in the Workshop menu
[*]Slow Stones visual effect now works properly
[*]Mason and Dividens skills don't work now before starting Wave 1
[*]It's easier to cast a spell on Elementals now
[*]Armadillo got right death sound
[*]Fixed repetitive items in the market
[*]Wealth skill is now required for learning Transformation skill
[*]Fixed the bug when the available space for placing stone shown red after destroying the stone at exact place
[*]Fixed the bug in story PvP missions where a player could start new wave with Space even it was impossible to do
[*]Sphere item now works properly
[*]Amount of maximum available start in the Map of Adventures is correct now
[*]Fixed the bug with walking animations during cast of Betelgeuse
[*]Unit under Transmutation spell is exploding now instead of dying
[*]Fixed the visual bug when player was available to research upgrades in the academy after maximum level was learnt
[*]Fixed the bug when status of the Order and Ninja Hall will be lost and "Summon Inquisitor" will be displayed again
[*]Avatar picture of Troll Bruiser is now correct
[*]Now you will receive a system message if the server shut down
[*]Fixed the visual bug at Skirmish and Heart of Corruption missions when the player could see red select circle on enemies
[*]Fixed the bug when upgrades icons were blinking after each mission completion
[*] Fixed some English texts in comics of Russian localisation
[/list]

Play with us,

notes.title: Major Update. Version 1.00 Beta is here! + Patch #2 + 30% OFF
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/08e76ce417b9a4f7d3cffc2797fb2c95fe145958.jpg[/img]
Hello there,

We have worked on this update for a month. This is the hugest update since Warstone release in April. We have totally redesigned whole skill tree. Some of wold skills become stronger. And.... We added 28 new skills. See below for more info about skills.

We increased Lvl cap by 5 levels. We added survival modes for 8 missions: In the Vicinity of the Temple, The Two Mountains, The Forest of the Amazons, The Cliff, The Dwarven Shooting Range, Astral, Crossroads, I'll Find You.

We increased mithril rewards for Challenge and Survival mission from 10-15 to 20-35. It should resolve the problem with a lack of mithril. These missions also give a lot of usual resources, for example, you can get up to 450 wood, 550 gold and 200 exp for completion survival mode of Crossroads mission.

Spells of Firewall and Ancestor Help were removed from the story. They are unique Sorcerer spells now. Sphere of Lightnings has been replaced with new spell "Thunderstom". "Bet" spell has been replaced with "Gold Chains" spell. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/c81a4b83aa90f1294f229e20d679af889245a889.jpg[/img]

Spells of Rune Items (Meteor Shower and Ancestor Help) were changed. Meteor Shower was replaced with Meteor (1 high damage meteor). Ancestor Help was replaced with Defender Spirit (+100% for 1 unit).

[h1]Changelog for Patch #2[/h1]
- Added 2 missing SP which was lost after the release of 1.00 update
-  Achievements for Survival missions of Astral and The Dwarven Shooting Range was fixed
- Fixed the bug with SueprUberMega skill when the player could buy it with no gold
- Fixed the bug with Spirit of Stone spell when you could lose 2 stones without any effect
- Added cooldown to Stone Explosion spell
- Added gold cost and cooldown to Golden Rush spell
- Golden Chains and Dividends skills now require only one previous skill to be able learnt
- Fixed the bug with Stone Explosion spell when a player could destroy the ston and leave a tower in the air :D
- Fixed some ability and skill descriptions for both languages
- Achievement for Challenge mode of Valley mission was fixed
- Achievements for Challenge mode of At a Rest Stop and The Horrors of the Dark Forest are easier now.
- Fixed a visual bug with story bubbles
- Fixed a visual bug when a tip bubble left after resetting skills


[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/100preview.jpg]

[h1]Sorcerer[/h1]
[list]
  [*]1) Fireball Damage rescaled from 25/35/50 to 40/40/55. Area +33%. Burning effect on Lvl 2 2dps ащк 10 seconds. Cooldown rescaled from 22/17/17 to 21/14/14. Manacost changed from 15 to 20
  [*]2) Mana skill rescaled from 15/30/50 per 1/1/1 sp to 15/50/100 per 1/2/3sp
  [*]3) Safekeeping SP costrescaled from 1/1/1 to 1/1/2
 [*]4) Storm. Slow effect changed from 40/40/75 to 40/40/60
Duration -2 seconds. Cooldown +5 seconds
[*]5)Teleport spell added. Allows to teleport an unit from one stone to another
Lvl 1 Adds ability
Lvl 2 Distance of teleportation +150%
Lvl 3 Cooldown -80%
[*]6) [u]New skill. Boost Charge.[/u] A closest allied unit gets 3/6/10 damage bonus after spell of lightning has been cast
[*]7) Lightning. Base damage was increased from 50 to 70
Skill damage effect rescaled from 15/25/35 to 15/20/20
Cooldown reduction rescaled from 5/3/2 to 4/4/3
[*]8) Saturation skill rescaled 
 Mana bonus from 3/5/7 to 3/5/10. SP cost from 2/2/2 to 1/1/2
[*]9) Added Lvl 2 and 3 to Sacrifice Skill
[*]10) Effecienty of Sorceresses skill rescaled from 15/30/45 to 9/24/40. SP cost from 2/2/2 to 1/2/2
[*]11)  Time skill rescaled from 15/30/45 to 20/40/60. SP cost from 1/1/1 to 2/2/2
[*]12) Inspiration. Restoration rescaled from 15/30/50 to 30/65/100. SP cost from 1/1/1 to 2/2/2
[*]13) Wisdom skill rescaled from 14/26/40 to 15/30/45
[*]14) Firewall spell removed from the story. Damage on Lvl 1 has been increased from 20 to 50 per second.
[*]15) Reduction skill was changed
Lvl 1 Base reduction decreased from 50% to 35%
Lvl 2 Time +50%, cooldown -33%
Lvl 3 Spell covers a small area. Manacost increases from 5 to 15
[*]16) Power of Air/Water/Fire spells rescaled from  20/45/75 to 12/37/75. SP cost from 2/2/2 to 1/2/3 sp
[*]17) [u]New skill. Penetration.[/u] Magic attacks and spells ignore 10%/20%/30% of magic resistance. 
[*]18) [u]New skill. Mana Juggler.[/u] A chance of decreasing the manacost of the next spell
Lvl 1 25% for 5 manacost
Lvl 2 35% for 7 manacost
lvl 3 40% for 10 manacost
[*]19) [u]New skill. War Fire.[/u] A random unit gets temporarily 25%/50%/75% damage buff after any spell has been cast
[*]20) [u]Sphere of Lightnings was replaced with Thunderstorm[/u]
Level 1 Lightnings deals 25 damage
Level 2 Number of Lightnings +33%. Cooldown -20%
Level 3 Damage increases from 25 to 40
[*]21) [u]New skill. Ancestors help.[/u] Summons spirits to help units in the battle
Lvl 1 Damage bonus +45%
Lvl 2 Duration +50%
Lvl 3 Damage bonus +75%
[*]22) Meteor Shower
Base damage +100%. Number from 3 to 4
Lvl 2 Add burning effect for 30 second 3dps
Lvl 3 +4 meteors
[*]23) [u]New skill. Double Shot.[/u] Elementals gains an ability to attack twice inquick session. Cooldown 26/18/11 seconds
[*]24) [u]New skill. Owl's Wisdom.[/u] The spell of summoning the warstone of Owl. 
Lvl 1 Manacost - 75, Cooldown - 300 seconds
Lvl 2 Cooldown -40%
Lvl 3 Manacost reduces to 55
[*]25) [u]New skill. Faerie Fire.[/u] Priestesses gain an ability to enchant  enemies increasing the damage dealt to them
Lvl 1 Magic damage increases by 40%
Lvl 2 Faerie Fire also slows the movement speed by 33%
Lvl 3 magic damage increaes by 75%. Cooldown -20%
[/list]
[img=http://battlecruiser.ru/wstd/100preview2.jpg]

[h1]Warlord[/h1]
[list]
  [*]1) Post-Haste skill rescaled from 25/50/75 to 20/40/80.  SP cost from 1/1/1 to 1/1/2
  [*]2) Berzerk. Number of attack changed from 5/7/9 to 6/7/8. Bonus attack speed rescaled from to 50/75/115 to 40/85/135. Higher levels now adds spell duration up to 75 seconds
  [*]3) Summoning Fury. Buff duration changed from 30s to 25s. Bonus damaged changed from 35/75/125 to 25/50/75
  [*]4) Hammer of Gods and Lightning sword abilities cost reduced by 5
  [*]5) Enchanted summoning time changed from 3/5/7.5 to 3/6/9
  [*]6) Summoners Privilege rescaled from 2/4/6 to 3/6/10
  [*]7) [u]New skill. Stone Aura.[/u] The spell of using energy of a stone for creating an magic aura.
Level 1 Increases Attack speed of nearby units by 20%
Level 2 Slows enemies by 25%
Level 3 Gives +33% damage aura for allied units. Requires 1 stone instead of mana for use
  [*]8) Sergeant skill renamed with War Craft  and rescaled from 12/9/3 to 12/8/4
  [*]9) Lieutenant skill renamaed with War Craft II and rescaled from 18/12/6 to 18/12/5
  [*]10) Captain skill renamaed with War Craft III and rescaled from 24/15/6 to 24/16/9 
  [*]11) [u]New skill. Morale.[/u] Every time  when a unit  gets a new rank then a manacost of Berzerk ability reduces by 2/4/6
  [*]12) [u]New Skill. Death Strike.[/u] Allows Assasins to get a special  ability in battle. Rapidly attack 4 enemies  poisoning them for 7 seconds. Poison deals 15 dps and slow targets by 80%
  [*]13) [u]New Skill. Magic Chakram.[/u] Allows Shiledmaidens to get a special ability in battle. Throws  an enchanted chakram which bounces 15 times and deals 50 damage to each
  [*]14) Spirit of the Stone. Level 1 gives Eagle warstone. Level 2 gives Tiger warstone. Level 3 reduces stone cost by 50%
  [*]15) Mason skill rescaled from 240/180/120 to 125/75/35 seconds. SP cost from 2/1/1 to 2/2/2
  [*]16) Keeper skill rescaled from 10/20/30 to 13/26/40
  [*]17) Portal skill rescaled from 40/60/100 to 40/70/100. SP cost from 2/1/2 to 2/2/2 sp
  [*]18) Dexterity skill rescaled from 10/20/30 to 11/22/33
  [*]19) [u]New skill. Corrosive shells.[/u] Allows riflemen to get a special ability in battle. Every shot decreases enemy armor by 1. Lasts 10 seconds. Effect stacks
  [*]20) [u]New skill. Stone explosion.[/u] Ability to destroy a stone to release its colossal energy
Lvl 1 Exlosion deals 100 damage
Lvl 2 Area of effect +33%
Lvl 3 Exsplosion deals 175 damage and decreases armor by 7. Requires stone instead of mana for a cast
  [*]21) [u]New skill. Stones of slow.[/u] Random stones emt energy waves which slow movement speed of  enemies
Level 1 Two Stones. 33% slow 
Level 2 Three Stones. Duration of slow +50%

Hello there,

We have worked on this update for a month. This is the hugest update since Warstone release in April. We have totally redesigned whole skill tree. Some of wold skills become stronger. And.... We added 28 new skills. See below for more info about skills.

We increased Lvl cap by 5 levels. We added survival modes for 8 missions: In the Vicinity of the Temple, The Two Mountains, The Forest of the Amazons, The Cliff, The Dwarven Shooting Range, Astral, Crossroads, I'll Find You.

We increased mithril rewards for Challenge and Survival mission from 10-15 to 20-35. It should resolve the problem with a lack of mithril. These missions also give a lot of usual resources, for example, you can get up to 450 wood, 550 gold and 200 exp for completion survival mode of Crossroads mission.

Spells of Firewall and Ancestor Help were removed from the story. They are unique Sorcerer spells now. Sphere of Lightnings has been replaced with new spell "Thunderstom". "Bet" spell has been replaced with "Gold Chains" spell.

notes.title: Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/37e7957204ab7d0cb5d72dc63ffce92ee2bad2f9.png[/img]

Hello there,

We are currently on a huge update which will bring the game to version 1.00. It means, it is the last big update before the game releases. It takes more time for preparing this update, so stay calm , we are working as fast as we can.

There is a list of upcoming changes

1) New 8 survival missions
2) Mithril rewards for Challenge and Survival missions will be increased up to 35
3) New 15 artifacts for Elemenetals, Novices, Shieldmaidens and Assassins.
4) Old skills will be changed. More than 25 new skills will appear

There are some of them
Sorcerer
1) A spell of summoning Warstone of Owl
2) Elementals and Priestess will get an useful ability
3) After casting a spell a random unit will receive a damage buff

Warlord
1) A spell of creating an powerful aura from the stone
2) Gold abilities for Shieldmaidens, Assassins and Riflemen
3) After receiving a rank by any unit a manacost of Berzerker spell will be reduced

Treasurer
1) In-game shop where you can buy scrolls or potions by gold
2) Rune magic which uses gold instead of mana for use
3) Super-Uber-Mega upgrades, which allow to buff any unit by gold

It comes as soon as possible

Stay with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major Update. Version 0.99 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/099435ade73f36b33b370b5523947c86a537ed98.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

This is the first major update after our small holidays, so we tried to bring more things to the game than we usually do.

So, today we have added EIGHT missions of challenge modes for the next missions: The Heart of Corruption, The Horrors of the Dark Forest, The Spirits' Gorge, Piedmont, Fight to the Death, The Valley, The Final, The Magic Gem. 

Actually, it means, that all challenges are completed now and you can take up to 99 of 100 Steam Achievements. We are going to complete Survival mode in the next 3-4 weeks.

[h1]New enemies and abilities[/h1]
We added 2 new enemy units in the last update, Wolf Rider and Black Bat.
So today we are going to complete enemy bestiary by adding 2 last units. So, meet Vanguard Rider, stronger version of Wolf Rider with speed aure ability and Death Bat, the most powerful bat with Vampire ability

We also changed numbers almost of all enemies. So, there is a full changelog:
[list]
    [*]Bat - Armor type was changed from Light to Unarmored
    [*]Armored Wolf - HP 60 -> 75
    [*]Troll Warrior -  HP 155 -> 175, Armor 5 -> 6
    [*]Chiroptera - Armor type was changed from Light to Unarmored, HP 60 -> 80
    [*]Black Bat - HP 70 -> 55
    [*]Ogre -  Base Regeneration 1 -> 2, Ability Regeneration 3.5 -> 5
    [*]Troll Champion - HP 320 -> 300, Armor 7 -> 8, Added Block Ability
Champion decreases damage by 55% in 25% of attacks
[*]Armored Boar - Armor type was changed from Normal to Heavy, Armor 9 -> 10
[*]Rhino - Base Regeneration 1 -> 2, Ability Regeneration 3.5 -> 5, Added Taunt ability
All nearby enemies are forced to attack Rhino, while his armor is increased by 5
[*]Troll Blademaster - HP 175 -> 150, Added Invisibility ability
Blademaster becomes temporarily invinsible after receiving serious damage
[*]Hell Boar - Bounty 10-15 -> 15-25, Added Hell Roar Ability,
Acceleration of closest enemies by 50% after death
[*]Troll Berserker - Added Enchanted Bone Armor ability
Berserker gets +2 armor after his health gets below 50% and 25%
[*]Imp - HP 40 -> 50
[*]Troll Bruiser - HP 135 -> 145, Armor 1 -> 2, Bounty 3-3 -> 5-5
[*]Avatar - HP 325 -> 375 Bounty 10-20 -> 20-25, Armor 20 -> 15, Armor type was changed from Normalto Unarmored
[*]Wolf Rider - HP 100 -> 90
[*]Vanguard Rider - HP 150 -> 125
[*]Grey Wolf - HP 25 -> 30
[/list]
Bounty of all enemies was slightly increased.
Numbers of enemies of missions before Crossroads mission remain the same to prevent an increase of difficulty for new players

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/45573ef7191876a5a56c082dc9d69aebb0cd9298.jpg[/img] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/ab98e7749fd9b8a5066e27fb8d37833e16177de4.jpg[/img]


[h1]Balance changes of player's units[/h1]
We have listened to the community feedback about the current balance. So there are thought and changes

[list]
    [*]Peasant. Added 1 damage upgrade which will increase his damage by 1-1
    [*]Archer. Max damage has been increased by 0-1
    [*]Rifleman. Base damage was increased and Added 1 damage upgrade which will increase his damage by 2-2
    [*]Bombarider. Max damage was icnreased by 3-5
[*]Spirit Elemental. Base damage has been increased by 5
[*]Warrior Elemental. Base damage has been increased by 10
[*]Knight. Starting damage of Crushing Blow ability has been increased by 10. The final damage was increased by 15
[*]Witcher. Damage from the ability was increased from 2 to 2.75 per attack
[*]Inquisitor. Spell of silence no mroe deals damage, but it has area of effect now
[*]Shiledmaiden. Damage of chakram has been reduced from 55% to 50%
[*]Valkyrie. The summon price was increased by 10
[*]Assasin. Maximum attack speed was reduced from 0.65 to 0.7. Damage decreases by armor before calculating Critical Strike now. 
[*]Ninja. Maximum damage has been reduced by 2-2. Damage from the Crushing blow ability has been rescaled from 40/60/80/100 to 80/100/125/155
[*]Novice. Base damage has been increased from 7-9 to 7-11. 
[*]Priestess. Max damage was increased by 3-4. Summon price was incresaed by 5
[/list]
[h1]Other changes[/h1]

- Mithril cost for all upgrades has been reduced by 20-25%. Mithril cost of attack abilities has been reduced by 45-50%
-Upgrades which decreases summon time now uses iron insted of wood
- The cost of defensive upgrades has been reduced by 15%
- The total cost of attack upgrades has been reduced by 35-45%
- Added visual effects for all aures and for Second life Ability
- Challenge mode of The Death Road is slightly easier now

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/61f707b4fa026ee4f698ea0be226fc9f77a0d29b.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/c68bd69b424c2711563261a8ed5ffb2f85d60d10.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a lot of red erros with the development console
- Armdaillo ability has been fixed
- Added missing ability icons for Wolf Rider and Bane
- Fireball Mitten item now works fine
- Gold Purse item now works fine
- Poisonous Cloud is no more endless

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
- (Next update) New Survival missions 
- (Next update) New items
- (Next update) Updated Game Classes system. New skills
- (Next update) Lvl cap increase
- Old School map
- Endless map
- New languages
- Linux port
- New missions in the Hot Air balloon
- UI improvements

We are still looking for Korean and Italian speakers who could help us with the localisation. If you can - add Rurik.

[h1]We need your feedback[/h1]

Bugs thread. 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1520386297704508871/

Balance discussion threades
ENG - http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1471967615859764179/
RU - http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1471967615859942028/

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Patch #2 for 0.98 version is here! + Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello there,

We fixed some bugs. There is a changelog:
- Fixed the bug when difficulty setting in the arena didn't work
- Gold Purse item works now right
- Added icon to Wolf Raider
- Fixed the bug when Boomba could stun already stunned units
- Mithril reward doesn't shows in the reward window for co-op missions if the player already passed it
- Fixed the bug with rewards for co-op missions
- Hitbox for Bats has been increased

Challenge mode of The Death Road is a little easier now

Armor type of Avatars is now unarmored (was normal). Armor has been decreased from 25 to 20

Hotfix #1
- Fixed the bug the lost progress. Update the game client. You could lose the progress for the last 12 hours. We are sorry for that. So we gave everyone 50 mithril as a compensation
- Fixed the bug with Priestess. They buff allies now
- Fixed the bug with the Bug Finder achievement.
Click on the bug under the tree again and then new dialogue "What is the beetle?" should appear and give you an achievement.
- Electric bettle now gets +1% damage per +2% magic damage (was 1/3)

Stay with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Warstone is almost ready! The price will be increased soon!
notes.content:
Hello there,

We have made a great job updating the game almost every week since 6 April. We finished the single campaign. It contains 33 missions now. Some of them weren't in the plan. We tried to listening the community and add things which people wanted. So we think, we made a huge job and we need a rest for now.

There won't be updates during next 10 days. But the work is keeping going. We are currently translating the game into 7 languages: German, Polish, French, Japanese, Chinese, Portuguese, Spanish. I think they will come closer to full release of the game. We also are interested in Korean and Italian localisations. So if you want to help us or probably you know someone who can help us - write a comment under this topic and we will contact with you.

notes.title: 0.97 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/7b75a8d15afac8d21a0b475e504c256b45c66f26.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

The game is almost ready, so we are polishing it right now. We added the last story mission in the previous update, so there are no new missions. But we added survival mode for Forest Edge, The Portal, Night Hunt missions. We think, missions of 3th should be hard, so here they are. Enjoy!

We increased the maximum level from 46 to 49. We will increase it up to 60 closer to the release of the game.

We added 2 monsters, Black bat is stonger version of Bat with magic resistance and Wolf Rider, who fast as wolf and deploy Troll Hunter after its death :D Funny unit!

We improved UI of arena. Now you can find more information the game and the player. It's easier to find the player of same pwoer as you now.

We changed PvP quests, they give mithril instead of SP, because there were a lot of players who thought they are forced to play PvP to get SP. So now, only people who want to play PvP will play it now, because there are a lot of other ways to get mithril.

We replaced some quests "Win PvP" with "Play PvP". It will help new players and will motivate them play a little.

You get 50% of reward if you lose in PvP.

Also, as you could notice we took away all Steam achievements whic was connected with PvP. Only one left "to play 1 battle in PvP", which is really easy.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/153dcffa2d30f3d7f4d3bc375db59d1c25ed39ba.jpg[/img]

Units' changes
- Base damage of Spirit Elementals has been increased by 5
- Base damage of Warrior Elemental has been increased by 10
- Attack range of bnoth Elementals has been increased by 25
- Cooldown of Astral Fire has been decreased from 35 / 25 to 15 / 10 seconds
- Base damage of Throw Grenade ability has been increased from 25 to 45
- Max damage of Archers has been increased by 0-1
- Slow of Bleeding has been reduced from 75% to 60%. Duration of bleeding has been reduced by 20%

We fixed a lot of bugs. But when I wrote this announcement at the first time I deleted all notes and I lost whole announcement text too. I can't remember what exactly we fixed. But there were a changelog with at least 25 fixed bugs. We fixed a lot of abilities and spells and other minor stuff.

[h1]Bug thread for 0.97[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1474221865191805008/

Support us with a Steam Review, If you like the game.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: 0.96 + Patch #3 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/c818658b9660a9f4f35ab28a1b96b9f22a7cfb67.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

So we added the last story mission in this update. The single campaign is now finished. 

Final mission is really tough mission. You need to use all your experience and strategy skills to bring trolls down in the 20 hardest waves. You will meet Boss 5 times. Each time he becomes stronger and gains new abilities. In 20th wave he comes with 2 Shaman Kings, which has powerful abilities, which could wipe out army. So, be ready, the final battle will be a ordeal for you.

You will also meet new enemy here, Avatar, powerful reincarnation of shaman in stone form. He has a large pool of health, strongest armor in the game in 3 deadly abilities. Mana drain allows him to steal mana from player pool and devour it increasing his health. He can cast a rain of stone fists which stun all units around him. He has Stone Skin, a passive ability, which stuns units which attack him.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/1c8c4b9e85716d32a232bc9ca60ae673214b19d4.jpg[/img]

After completing the Final mission you will unlock Castle IV and tons of new upgrades. Also, you will see a lot of final story comics and game credits. I hope, you will like them.

We redesigned Elementals. We decreased their damage and increased their cost and dramatically increased their attack range. Elemental Warrior with all upgrades can shot up to 575 range. It could cover almost all map. So, Elementals now is very useful unit for building your own strategy. We also improved Astral Fire ability.

There was a bug with Bug finder achievement. Funny: D
Click on the beetle again when read the dialogue and you will receive an achievement.

We added Challenge mode for the Outpost and Ordeal missions and 4 Steam Achievements.

We added 3 mithril upgrades (in attack) for Armored Wolf, Alpha Eagle and Priestesses for people who has their buildings. If you have got all of them, be sure you have got the next upgrades in the workshop: 1) Speed Aura 2) Second Life 3) Weakening.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/093b1666dd5427759000d95b9983754cd4a2c94d.jpg[/img]

We fixed a lot of bugs. There is a changelog:
- Some typos has been corrected
- Fixed a bug with no appeared warstones of Tiger and Owl in Piedmont mission
- Fixed a bug when wave bar didn't fill after playing PvP mission
- Units which are summoned by scenario are no more affected by Portal skill
- Fixed a bug when you could receive 2 Castle buildings in the town
- Fixed a bug when player received stone every time when warstone appeared if he learnt Mason skill
- Fixed a bug when icon of barrack in the workshop didn't blink when player received new upgrade
- Added cost for Crushing blow and Ghost Blow ability
- Items which improve spells now works properly

Bug fixes of Patch #1
- Fixed the bug with 4,5 levels of Throw Grenade ability
- Fixed the bug with Mana drain ability for Boars
- Fixed the bug with challenge mode of At a Rest Stop mission
- Fixed the visual bug, when players got 2 Castle buildings at the town
- Battle meditation ability of Boomba works properly now
- Fixed wrong achievement for Final mission. If you passed it earlier, you are lucky, because real one is insane
- Fixed missing text for English achievements
- Some upgrade descriptions has been updated
- Blank skills has been removed
 
Bug fixes of Patch #2
- Fixed wrong entrance/exit icons in Ordeal (Challenge)
- Added missing icon for Satellite ability
- Fixed some red errors in the Arena
- Fixed the bug with a lot of sounds effects
- Warcry ability now works properly
- Speed ability of Razorback now works properly
- Defensive Stance of Mercenaries now works properly
- Throw grenade ability of Bombardiers has been fixed

The 20 wave in Final mission become easier. Cooldowns of Sleep and Curse of Shaman King has been increased by 80%

Bug fixes of Patch #3
- Templars casts his ability which reduces armor only when enemy is near him now
- Avatar casts Stone Fists properly now
- Warcry ability works fine now
- Fixed the bug when throw spear wasn't counted for achievements
- Fixed ability of  Boomba in the Night Hunt mission
- Fixed the bug when player could receive old quests

[h1]Bug thread for 0.96[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/2579854400740375342/

Support us with a Steam Review, If you like the game.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.content:
Hello there,

We fixed some bugs which came with 0.95 update. There is a changelog:

- Fixed red errors in the console at the Valley mission

- Added possibilty to summon Knight/Witcher/Shieldmaiden/Assasin for players who purchased the services of Mercenery for mithril

- Chance of Evade for Eagles has been rescaled from 15/25/35/45/55 to 15/22/28/34/40

- Base armor of Alpha Eagle has been increased from 4 to 6. The maximum armor (after upgrades) has been increased from 7 to 10. So, it takes almost zero damage against unupgraded archers
- Base health of Alpha Eagles has been decreased from 100 to 85
- Summon price of Alpha Eagles has been increased from 70 to 100

We hope these changes will add more balance into PvP.

Stay with us,
Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Major Update. Version 0.95 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/07ff20e8a2e05fe14e0aa8097bcdbe483b9bd4d6.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

There were a delay with this update, because there are really a lot of new content. We planned that Fight to the Death will be the last mission in the campaign. But we decided to add new missions as we said before. So, there is a new mission after Fight to the Death. We added comics at the end of this mission to connect this mission with a new one. There is it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/4fa390870230198b571ed6a84b0b79e2819b3ced.jpg[/img]

So, new story mission, Valley. It is a maze mission with 2 entrances. I can assure you, there is a lot of strategic possibilities to pass this mission. Also, there is one special feature like in Night Hunt mission. Ice crystal spawns a wave, which randomly freezes your units. This mission could be impossible, but you will get new scroll magic at this mission. It is Purge, which lets you to dispel any debuff.

Also, we usually add 1 new monster per update. There is THREE new units. Armadillo is hardly defensive Gremlin, which can increase his armor, Elemental Spirit with Resurrection ability, which brings him to life with 50% HP after the death, and Elemental Warrior with Void Stone ability, which slows attack speed of nearby units.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/4ce51b1fa6adf301aaf7f6e658d6ac91fb1232d1.jpg[/img]

You will unlock the most powerful unit in the game during the mission. It is Elemental Warrior. It has extremely high damage 135 - 175. He can wipe out Hell Boar in just 2 shoots. Very useful unit against high armored units.

It has Satellite ability, which allows him to bring lesser elemental into the battle with 25 damage. As a attacker has resurrection ability, which lets him revive after the death with 100% health. He also has Void Stone ability, which slows attack speed of enemy units up to 250%.

You can see/test attack and defense type of this unit at the Valley mission.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/65810ee0b6da83e2257590000588119c80bf4982.jpg[/img]

We introduce new menu. It is encyclopedia. If you meet new enemy in the battle, it will be added to the book. You can find all necessary information about all monsters and theirs abilities. Also, there is information about your troops as a Tower and as a Unit as well. We added difficulty buttons for you. So now you can see how much health will have any monster in the Challenge mode on Nightmare difficulty.

You will unlock Magic Academy Level 2 after completing Valley mission. It gives you 10 extra magic upgrades. So you will be able to increase you magic power up to 100%.

We have also added Challenge mode for "I'll Find You" and "At a Rest Stop" missions.

As you could notice, we take away PvP Achievements. We replaced them with 4 story achievements. There is only 1 PvP achievement left. But it is really easy. You just need to win 1 battle in the PvP.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/e8db05d0af6bebfa850d5725e210a382a2991934.jpg[/img]

We fixed some bugs. There is a changelog:
- Fixed the bug with Dexterity skill, which gave Bombardiers double bonus
- Added possibilty to summon Shieldmaidens/Assasins if the player had Valkyrie/Ninja
- Fixed the bug with broken Arena
- Fixed a bug when some high leveled upgrades granted low level abilities
- Wisdom skills no more affect on Nechai's abilities cooldowns
- Fixed the wrong death sound for Hell Boar
- You can click / cast spells through units' chevrons 

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1471967529575207145/

If you like Warstone, we will be really grateful to you if you support us with Steam Review.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games
