notes.title: Major update! v0.94 + Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/8f5266b2388fd183f0f2a0921898eeacdff0499f.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

There is news for new update which actually came on 16 July. It's late, because we wanted to make some hot fixes. It took more time than we expected.

First of all, there was a huge bug with damage skills of Warlord, Brutal Force and Warlord. They gave extra damage multiple times for upgraded units. For example, Knight Templar could have extra 324% bonus damage instead of 81%. So, this bug made a game as Warlord as an easy walk. We fixed it. Warlord class is not overpowered now.

We added new story map, Piedmont. You should help Valkyries and Ninjas with protecting of borderlands against assault of troll army. Map is really hard. But new powerful units will help you. Valkyrie has Warcry ability which increases attack damage of nearby allies. Ninjas have Finishing blow ability, which could kill enemy with low amount of health instantly, even Ogre.

Valkyrie as a PvP unit has got Last will ability, which increases movement speed of nearby allies when she dies. Ninjas have bot invisibility, which let them become invulnerable against physical attacks.

You will meet new enemy on this map, Troll Bruiser. He has extremely powerful aura, which increases health of nearby allies by 50% and give them 3 points of extra health regeneration. He improves the strength of trolls significantly. So, have a good game: D

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/5ad1b2ecbed2ce6d337f83c0da69584789bba228.jpg[/img]

We have added some features which you are asked us to add. There are hotkeys now: "space" for starting new wave, "shift" for game speed settings, "mouse wheel" for zoom and "esc' for a menu.

If you will get new upgrade it will blink. It will help you to find new upgrades among others.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- Added missing comics
- Fixed a bug when players saw number of starts instead of score in their rating
- Player now can choose which item will disappear when he will get new item with full warehouse
- Fixed the bug when visual effect of summon could disappear if player starts summon new unit.
- Fixed the bug when players couldn't buy gold abilities for Inquisitor and Templar
- Memory skill gives now 1/2/4 extra slots instead of 1/3/5
- Some Cyrillic tooltips in English version of the game was removed
- "Portal" skill now affects upgrading units too.
- Priestess now applies high level slow effects
- Added small icons for Bane's abilities
- Added units icons in upgrades for Templars and
- Fixed visual effects in the Knight's Earth Shake ability
- Added achievement’s text for missions from previous update
- Chakram ability works properly now 
- Stunning Chakram ability has been removed
- Added stone icon for Ninja
- Fixed the bug when console with errors could appear when player was using spell of Ancestors Spirits
- Added a better explanation for max level of magic upgrade in the academy

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/2aa10e9b0221ef152fa7e61cf88b6d1fb17a1d18.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes of Patch #1[/h1]
- Fixed the bug when players couldn't start a map if they were playing on high graphics settings in Mac
- Mithril arrows now give 150% damage with 33% chance instead of 200% damage with 25% chance
- Fixed the bug when players couldn't research upgrades for Valkyries and Ninjas if they were unlocked with mithril
- Wrong buildings for Templars and Inquisitors has been removed
- Fixed the bug when players could get possibility to summon Templars and don't have one for Knights
- Fixed the bug when random buildings could appear in the city when story buildings were removed
- Player couldn't break a scenario in the Rift mission
- Players couldn't break a scenario when replay Astral mission
- Staff of Astral Spirits has been removed from the market
- Fixed Entry/exit icons in the Piedmont mission
- Reward for co-op missions can be received now

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/8f5266b2388fd183f0f2a0921898eeacdff0499f.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

There is news for new update which actually came on 16 July. It's late, because we wanted to make some hot fixes. It took more time than we expected.

First of all, there was a huge bug with damage skills of Warlord, Brutal Force and Warlord. They gave extra damage multiple times for upgraded units. For example, Knight Templar could have extra 324% bonus damage instead of 81%. So, this bug made a game as Warlord as an easy walk. We fixed it. Warlord class is not overpowered now.

We added new story map, Piedmont. You should help Valkyries and Ninjas with protecting of borderlands against assault of troll army. Map is really hard. But new powerful units will help you. Valkyrie has Warcry ability which increases attack damage of nearby allies. Ninjas have Finishing blow ability, which could kill enemy with low amount of health instantly, even Ogre.

Valkyrie as a PvP unit has got Last will ability, which increases movement speed of nearby allies when she dies. Ninjas have bot invisibility, which let them become invulnerable against physical attacks.

You will meet new enemy on this map, Troll Bruiser. He has extremely powerful aura, which increases health of nearby allies by 50% and give them 3 points of extra health regeneration. He improves the strength of trolls significantly. So, have a good game: D

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/5ad1b2ecbed2ce6d337f83c0da69584789bba228.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major update! v0.93
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/2fa390fecc45a7e15f63ff0a2fec59a510dd906a.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

This update is huge. 

First of all, meet new story mission, Heart of Corruption. We think, it looks awesome :D And, it's really interesting, because you will get 2 powerful melee units in this mission, Knight Templar and Inquisitor. First one has extremely high damage and an ability to lower enemy armor by 6. The second one can perform special attack, which silence the enemy preventing him from using abilities.

The most interesting part of this mission is new enemy, Bane. Powerful representative astral aliens. He has 3 abilities. Wow. Like a mini-boss. He can send units to astral preventing them from attacking. He cast it on himself when gets damaged. And, after death he sends closest units to astral. Really tough guy. Every fight with him is like a fight with boss.

So, I assure you, new mission is very cool.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/010522eeb5f2b60cd5e99fa0e31fb45b6e384560.jpg[/img]

After completing the mission, you ll see 2 story comicses, which should be funny and unlock new buildings for new units. Both units has mithril uprades for their abilities. Their attack abilities are aures (armor and resistance). It should give more tactic to PvP game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/616ce3adb6b3440af23646412185d111cc49acef.jpg[/img]

We added possibilty to build Hot Air Balloon to enable new mission. But there is no menu now. We will add this in future updates. We also added 3 Steam Achievements.

Challenge mode for The Cliff and The Dvarwen Shooting Range is available now.We added repetitve rewards for all Challenge and Survival missions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/4b910869f8e5a8f349c4179749b88c591e98b894.jpg[/img]

We added new featruefor co-op missions, to make it interesting to play for all players. Reward in co-op missinos is sharing now for noth players. So, there will be no situations, when one player could do nothing expect using spells.
Give us a feedback about this.

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
- Damage of Spirit Elemental has been increased by 10
- Damage of Lightning Sword ability has been increased from 75 to 100. Cost has been decreased from 50 to 40
- Damage,Area of effect and Cost of Gods Hammer ability has been increased by 50%
- Bleeding (amazon ability) lowers the movement speed for 75% instead of 80%
- Rhino now has normal armor (was unarmored)

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- Moonwell 2 gives increased production now.
- Some typos has been fixed
- Armored Wolf in PvP no longer have heal ability
- Fixed the wrong scenario in the prologue mission
- Fixed the bug when story comicse for "Architector has not mithril" wasn't shown
- Fixed the bug when some rewards from missions was shown incorrectly
- Fixed the bug with russian decription for tooltip for max lvl.
- Betelgeuse model in Astral mission has been rep-laced with new one.

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/2592234299575039868/

If you like Warstone, we will be really grateful to you if you support us with Steam Review.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major update! v0.92
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/b79d030ae746c99777241a95092838a8b141c7c3.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

[h1]About update[/h1]

There were a lot of feedbacks from you for last week. Thank you all. We planned what new mission; Fight to the Death will be the last in the story. It might seem as the end of the game, when you will finish it, but it's not.
We decided, it's not cool to give new units after the completion of the campaign. There are 5 units left: Valkyrie, Ninja, Knight Templar, Inquisitor and Elemental Warrior. So we decided to add them into 4 new story missions. It's good news, we suppose. They come in the next updates as usual.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/a7e9514c4a1c8d30f423245fa4c17c1f4581af97.jpg[/img]

So, there is new mission, Fight to the death. You need to power up the crystal. During the mission you will unlock new basic unit, Elemental Spirit. It's a very powerful and expensive unit with slow attack speed and high damage (45 -65). It helps you to defend the mission against new enemies, Hell Boars and new Boss, because they deal extra damage to heavy armor. So, try them in battle.

notes.title: Major update! v0.91
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/bf86e26bd02c4730b17c6db9afbc5ad7cdae3d49.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

The story campaign is almost finished. We have added new mission, The Dark Forest, in this update and the last one comes with the next one.

So, new story mission is unusual. It start as "Astral" mission. You control Nechai and you need to use 4 abilities to prevent monsters for reaching the end of the path. I said, this mission is unusual, because you will unlock the ability to summon usual units after the 5 wave. So, you need to control a hero and spend gold for units. It's a really tough task. We hope, you will like this mission.

The survival mode for "Collaboration" and the challenge mode for "The Vicinity of the Temple" are unlocked now. 2 more Steam achievements are available now.

We ahve unlocked The Armored God Wolf Statue. After building it you will be able to summon Armored Wolfs from Wolfs in PvP battles. When CAstle 4 comes, they will get Seconds Life aility, which will allow them to ressurect in the astral form. Useful unit.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/9ca0ccef2fa519855676c583a306f1c2f413d6f2.jpg[/img]

The portal is now active. After killing a certain amount of monsters at the missions (75 for a start) you will receive a gift with a random resource.

You can get:
Gold 50-125
Wood 20-55
Iron 25-65
Mana 15-45
Mithril 1-2

The reward is increased with you level for +100% for every 10 levels. So at the level 50, you can get up to 12 mithril for 1 gift.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/01bf96a1dac32971995adf74ab0e4a461a12fdc2.png[/img]

We fixed some bugs:
- Fixed the critical at the server code which could broke the game
- Fixed the bug with movement speed bonus of Razorbacks and "Storm" spell
- Fixed the confuse with Earth and Water magic upgrades at the Academy
- Fixed the bug when the player could visually get 5 mithril form the totem
- Fixed the bug when units didn't attack some monsters in the Outpost mission
- Fixed the bug when the player could learn unavailable skills with double-click
- Fixed the bug when melee units were continuing attack the flying monsters even the stun is ended
- Fixed the bug when Wisdom skill didn't visually change the cool downs
- Fixed the bug with Mithril Arrows item0% for every 10 levels. So at the level 50, you can get up to 12 mithril for 1 gift.
- If damage bonus from sergeant skill is less than 1 it will show with fractions now.

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/2333276539601643947/

If you like Warstone, we will be really grateful to you if you support us with Steam Review.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major update! v0.90
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/540703edf1874bb98a7ef13dbe45d453816fdd64.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We read your feedback in the community hub every day. You offered a lot of good ideas. Thank you.

There are 2 of them. We added restart button in the menu. So, you don't need to exit to the city, open the map of adventures and click start button. It's really simple now.

The second is the caravan, new building, which allows you to trade resources. You can spend some mithril to instantly get some resources. It is very useful ability for people who need resources for preparation and buildings quests. At higher levels of caravan you will be able to trade resources for mithril. This option is very useful for veterans who are already researched all upgrades in the workshop. We need more mithril!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/8b2132872f5bea7cab2743e95aedbcb5ba8c7290.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/95920ca04699109558f5be506569134ae7fb088f.png[/img]

We added new story co-op mission, The Magic Gem. It is a map with 2 crossed roads and one interesting feature. It should be fun. Try it.
After completing it, you will unlock the level 3 of the Mine. It would be useful for players who play PvP missions, because iron is the most used resource for PvP upgrades.

Also, we added TWO missions in the survival mode: The Forest of the Gloom and The Rift, plus 3 Steam Achievements.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/4a1b2a1253a57bdafc0bd06e77bc8f3b4e9d8629.jpg[/img]

We fixed some bugs. There is a changelog for current ones:

- Fixed the bug with numbers of cooldowns and Wisdom skill
- Fixed the bug when player could target the enemies' towers with double-click
- The color of assassin is blue now (was always green)
- Fixed the wrong animation of armored wolf as tower

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1354868867714436922/
If you would like us to go top of the class regardless, please give us a small review on the Steam. New units, mission and building will appear at the next update.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/7480a82126f905e6b994a0fd9dda2568acccddf1.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

We have added targeting for units. If you double-click the monster, all units will start attack it. There is no beautiful visuals effect for now, we are going to add one soon.

We have also added the ability to learn the skill in the Tree of Wisdom with double-clicks.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/78347de09f95a4ee6d75ac15e1f38e85feb91e42.jpg[/img]

Meet new story mission, The Spirit's Gorge, the nice looking map in the maze mode. There a lot of possible positions for stones, so it's should be fun. You will force new enemy here, Necro, the powerful shaman with Curse and Reincarnation abilities.

During the mission you unlock new warrior, Priestess, the upgrade of Novices. She has higher damage and Blessing ability, which increase the attack speed of allied units. Useful unit.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/72ccbd10da63a0a585ec159dc405a1804b1edaec.png[/img]

After finishing the construction of the Temple you will unlock new building, magic runes. It could increase gaining experience up to 50%. But requires mithril for a construction.

We have also added the challenge mode for The Forest of the Amazons and 2 Steam achievements.

We fixed some bugs. There is a changelog for current ones:

- Mysticism and Tribute skills work properly now.
- Fixed the bug when 1 monster could get stuck after position of the stone in classical missions.
- The armor reduction in the Spear throw ability and Movement speed decrease in the Notched Arrows ability now work properly.
- Fixed some red errors connected with casting of spells
- Some improvements in maze missions
- Fixed the bug when the screen froze for a second when a soundtrack was changed.
- It's possible to use now Rune of Ancestors Spirits and attack speed buff at the same time
- fixed the bug when player got 1 stone in the start of the mission, if Mason skill was learnt.
- The skills Dexterity now affects on Bombardier
- The skill in Treasurer "Businessman" starts working right after learning.
- The power of Earth now increases the damage of Titan's Fist
- The power of Air now increase the damage of Electric Beetle
- If one player will failed the achievement in co-op missions, it will show to the other player now.
- The Cry Before Death ability was removed from Assassin and Valkyrie in the Outpost mission
- Visual bug in the menu of the attack were fixed
- Tootlip Тролли in the story PvP missions has been replaced with Trolls
- Some chat improvements
- The apocalypse mode is now shown in the list of the modes in the arena

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1291817837624055444/
If you would like us to go top of the class regardless, please give us a small review on the Steam.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major update! v0.88
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/525e7a90706b0cf9a223420ca41b23606df58438.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

There is a new weekly major update, as we promised.

We added new story mission, On the March. It's PvP type mission against troll. It should be interesting to play. You need to win before 20th round starts or big bad trolls come and you definitely lose! You will meet new enemy, Troll Champion, a tough warrior with  heavy armor.

We have also unlocked the challenge mode for the Two Mountains mission.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/b223ee7873f935269dc964d7b85a176d6ba82eb2.jpg[/img]

There are two big features which came with this update. Firstly, We added rewards for getting stars. You can get 10-50 of wood / iron / gold / mana / experience and even mithril for each rank of the star. For example, there is a 30 experience reward for getting the bronze star for the Dwarven Shooting Range mission. You will get 30 experience for silver and bronze stars as well. Actually, so you can pass it on the Nightmare difficulty and get 3 times per 30 experience ( 90 exp at all).

We think, this feature will motivate players getting stars now. Also, it is a way for farm resources in solo as you asked!

The second thing is changeable amounts of reward for completing missions. Now it depends on the difficulty. If you play on easy the reward remains the same, but if you will play on Normal you will get 125% of base amount. There are 150% for Hard and 185% for Nightmare difficulties.

This feature doesn't affect people who plays TD on easy for relaxing. But I think, it will motivate people who like challenges to buy scrolls and trying to complete it on the higher difficulty to get better reward.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/69d1f3e1a1a59b87f49e22732388d2d3ce57a0dd.png[/img]

A lot of people were complaining about "Preparation" quests. So we have decided to lower the goals in this type of quests. For example, you were need to research Black Gunpowder lvl 1, Dexterity lvl 3 and Peddlers lvl 2 for completing the Preparation III quest. Now you need to make only Black Gunpowder lvl 1, and Dexterity lvl 2 upgrades.

We have also replaced the Endurance with Hunting Armor, because it required completing the PvP quest. The new one is the story given upgrade.

People who got these quests before 0.88 update must to complete these quests with old objections. Or you can ask Rurik to close them manually.

We finished the improving the info menu. It looks much better now. We also fixed some bugs with the spell recharging system. We have a question for you. Should we increase the size of unit icons in the summoning menu?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/835f32d18befd0ab4e7415984feb50a885fb031a.png[/img]

We fixed some bugs. We are going to fix about 30-40 in the next major update. There is a changelog for current ones:

- The player can set the pause only 2 times in the PvP game now. Another player now have an ability to unpause the game.
- Fixed the bug when the player lost 125 mithril and got another option for huntresses without his actions.
- Fixed the bug when the peasant appeared after the witcher used the lightning sword ability
- The item, Mithril arrows, now works properly
- The high number of victories in the campaign rating has been fixed. It calculates properly now.

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1291817208483570697/
If you would like us to go top of the class regardless, please give us a small review on the Steam.

P.s. Rurik will be out of inernet for a week. He will try to find the internet as soon as possible for continuing the answering your questions and solving your problems in the forum. The programmer will keep fixing bugs and watching the server. So there will be update at the next week anyway. Just be calm, if we will no fix bugs for a while.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major update! v0.86
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/8bf54d97197522441b8da20e8684352a03a167f8.jpg[/img]

Hey there,

First of all, we have returned game speed settings. Thanks for your understanding. We have also added them to PvP battles. We aren't sure it's good idea. So, we need your feedback.

We have improved the reconnection system. It should work much better now.  If you got connection errors, you will be able to log in again at the same time. We have fixed "The user is currently online" bug.

The main feature of this update is unusual co-op mission, The Horrors of the Dark Forest.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/d72ff1cf791c0bccf6b704fa87a5370cc9b86af8.jpg[/img]

It's the biggest map among existing ones. There are many useful spots. Also, the tree in the center  of the map is special. It increases the movement speed of closest enemies. So, you must think twice before placing units on stones. Strategy is needed. Enjoy!

We are constantly checking  community hub for suggestions. There are balance changes:

- The cost of Novices decreased by 5
- The base time of "Slow" (Novice's passive ability) increased from 1.75s to 2.75s
- The cost of Knight and Witcher increases by 5
- The damage of "Spear Throw" ability decreased from 12/12/20/20/30 to 12/12/18/18/24
- The damage of "Sword of Lightings" Witcher's ability increased from 40 to 75
- The damage of "Gods Hammer" Knight's Ability increased from 10 to 20. The area of effect is lowered by 25%


We have added 2 Steam achievements and the challenge mode for "Night Hunt" mission. It's really tough.

We fixed some bugs. There is the changelog:
- Fixed the bug, when the player could build Sanctuary and unlock Knight
- The spalsh attack of dwarfes doesn't affect ghost wolfs now
- Dexterity skill in Warlord's path works now properly
- Fixed the bug when the player could lose items when he reseted Backpack skill
- The elemantal summon doesn't count as unit summon in star achievements
- The circle of unit summon has been deleted in the start of Astral mission
- Fixed the bug when a chevron was showed over spell icons
- Fixed the bug "Every time co-op game starts - popup message appear: "Player cancelled start of the game"
- 

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1334600128974487533/

If you would like us to go top of the class regardless, please give us a small review on the Steam.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major Update! v0.85
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/15c277876be11f890fec675839b39d5cb401d833.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

This week was really hard, because we forced with server errors at the beginning of the week and our only programmer got sick. Anyway, it looks like we could handle it and there is a small update at this week as we promised.

We have added new story mission "The Road of the Death". You ll face new enemy, Ghost Wolves, which are immune to any physical damage. So you need you use magic to kill them.

There will be new warstones with spirit of owl which will help you with this task. When the warrior standing on the warstone of owl kills a monster, he gets, apart from the reward in gold, a double mana reward. Try new stones in battle!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/2cfdc8f9ba88af924b854e13e46d996d82d70e9f.jpg[/img]

When you complete new mission you unlick new building in the town, the Magic Academy. You can improve the power of 4 school magic up to 150%. Sorcerer's path is getting more powerful now. 

For magic upgrades you will need mana, which you can collect in the moonwell. Mana is also used in ability upgrades for units, like Heal or Crushing Strike. So, your total power is definitely getting stronger with this update.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/dfdfa2d572944e754fc8cf559711a2f927b42f02.png[/img]

The last new feature in this update, which people asked about it, so there is it, a daily production in the city.  You can collect gold, iron, wood, mana every day in the city. The amount of resources you gather depends on the level of the building.

Gold 30 / 60 / 90
Wood 55 / 75
Iron 40 / 65
Mana 50 

Also, the gold mine is now available. You can build it and improve the gold income up to 150%. 

We added 4 new Steam achievements.

We fixed some bugs. There is the changelog:
- Fixed the bug, when the player couldn't learn "Memory" spell in Sorcerer's path
- Fixed the bug, when a gremlin got stuck in the first wave of Ordeal mission
- The visual bug with mithril reward in co-op mission has been fixed

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1327844097125877799/

If you would like us to go top of the class regardless, please give us a small review on the Steam.

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Games

notes.title: Major Update! v0.84 + Arena is back!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/740e83ce3fe06f76050fb6988360a50f5d7c028c.jpg[/img]

Hello there,

Firstly, we have a serious bug in the server code and fixed it. So, the arena is unlocked now.
We are going to return game speed setting and recconect syetem in a couple of days. We need to be sure that it works fine.

Secondarily, we have added 2 new story missions "Ordeal" and "At the Rest". The first one is the mission with 2 exits and a lot of warstones. The second one is a maze level.

You will force 2 new enemies, Shaman and Troll Chanter. A troll wizard has heal ability. The troll with banner has +5 armor aura. They are hard to kill both, so you should foucs your fire.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/ee42d20cdcad091ffae181a8a1e358b22602b5fc.jpg[/img]

Challenge modes for "Battle on the Meadow" and "The Forest of Gloom" are back. We have also added "Forest Edge" in this mode.

Finally, we introduce Survival mode. Enemies have bonus of 75% HP and +2 armor. The missions in this mode are really hard, one big wave of monsters without any rest. You can try it now on "The Beginning" mission

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/64bfb030315716d51f757cb562f8b1f7507235a0.jpg[/img]

We have fixed several bugs. There is a changelog:

- Fixed the bug when a player could lose SP after reset of skills.
- Fixed the bug when player could receive red console message during the prologue mission.
- Fixed the bug when a player couldn't summon Bombardiers on "I'll Find You" mission
- Fixed the bug when players couldn't get gold stars for completing co-op. mission if they were playing on nightmare difficulty.
- Fixed the visual bug when a player have got bronze star if he even passed the level on gold.
- Fixed "Fury skill + any unit attack rate" bug.
- A lot of typos has been fixed

We are watt your comments about this update!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1319962329030884053/

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Major Update! v0.83
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/d085be98730020b649002cd69d26a6c53b5761db.jpg[/img]

Hey there,

We have collected feedback from you over the past two weeks. Thank you for a lot of nice ideas. We are prodly present some of them today

- The game speed settings has been added to the game. There are 2 extra seetings, 1,5x and 2x. You can chage them any time using the button in the top upper corner.
- The reward for co-op missions is now repetitve. Also, we cut temporarily resource reward for PvP missions, because players abused them.
- Units don't use target abilities on allied units now (like spear throw of Mercenary)
- We have added new feature in the town. If there is any game hosted in the Arena, when the fire burns. If there is no games, there is no fire. 
- We have added some sound effects to the Arena, so you can now undestand if you are in Alt-tab when the game started or somebody wrote a message.

Challenge mode for "The Forest of Gloom" and "The Battle on the Meadow" is available now.

We are constantly working on fixing bugs. There are some of them.
- Fixed the bug with "Tribute" skill when player could lose iron instead of getting it
- Heal ability has been removed for Giant Eagles
- Armor upgrades for units in PvP show coreectly now.
- Sphere of lightning can be used now
- Fixed the bug in "Rift" mission when the game could crush when Shaman King used "Sleep" spell on a unit which were upgrading
- Missing name for new monsters has been restored

We are going to add Mac support in a couple of days. New missions will be available next week. You ll get 3 new units: Knight and Witcher + Wolf for PvP battles.

We ll be glad to hear your feedback about this update in our forum.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1319961868326860623/

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Major Update! v0.82
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/8187d2a5f9f32caa862669a8e56dfd07c7b182ba.jpg[/img]

Hey there,

Two weeks have passed since Warstone release.  And there is an second major update for the game.

We have added 3 new story missions. You unlock the new unit, Bombardier, after completing the "The Dwarving Shooting Range" mission. Also, you ll reveal the new warstone at this mission and 10 Steam Achievments.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/c4ea25360b8b65714d72572c13e93ea616a71c13.jpg[/img]

You ll meet 3 new enemies: Robust Gremlin, which is stronger than usual Gremlin and has magic resistance, Troll Blademaster, the ultimate version of Troll Hunter and Ogre, a really tough troll with health regeneration.

You will unlock new mithril upgrades for units, which gives an extra ability for units. For example, Mercenary as an attack unit will be able to take a defensive stance that decreases damage taken by 20%.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/a6e7411da9ed368c73731d0238d1b07e91c7393d.jpg[/img]

The players who has got 10 lvl will find a lot of new items in the market. We have added a lot of artifactes, items with permament effect. For example, you can buy the Novice's Stuff to increase the damage of Lighting spell and etc.

We have added 2 extra stones at start for all PvP missions as you asked.
The price of health potions has been increased also.

We have added the Challenge mode for the "Collobaration" mission. Take a look. It's really hard mission.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/e6ecb9e66b577fe5cfea89ee1a5f56d01f9315da.jpg[/img]

We have fixed a lot bug also. There is a changelog: 

- Fixed the bug when the effect of Rend spell could dissappear
- Fixed the bug when a speed potion left in hands of Boomba after he thrownt it
- Some UI and typos fixes

 
We are going to add the game speed setting and Mac support at the next update.

We need your feedback! Tell us what you think in our community hub!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/1319961618828962875/

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Team

notes.content:
We are continuing to bring the game to the ideal state.
There is a changelog:

- Fixed the bug when some players didn't receive stones in PvP battles
- Fixed the critical bug when the game froze after using the spell "Alacrity" on unit which were upgrading

- The campaign rating is formed correctly now
- Fixed graphical bugs in the city with monitors of 16:10 ratio screen resolutions
- Fixed the bug when prices in the market didn't change with the learnt skill "Sale"

- The player doesn't need to wait 90s now if his ally left from co-op mission

- The text for achievement resets now after each mission start
-The chat log in multiplayer games doesn't carries over from session to session now
- Black fields with completed upgrades disappear automatically now
- Fixed the bug in Astral map when the white circle stayed  after hero  teleportation
- Fixed the bug when you couldn't highlight the next skill in the Tree of Wisdom after learning one
- Fixed the bug with a wrong text in the info bubble after scrolling of the Tree of Wisdom
- Fixed the bug when the menu of attack could appear in the main menu
- Fixed the bug when Nechai doesn't turn around while using "Dissecting  Blow" ability
- Some UI fixes

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Major Update! v0.81
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/7bce88971c5aaf4d672dd3887de48b6b2f05eec7.jpg[/img]

Hey there,

We’ve been focusing on getting you fixes for the more serious bugs.
But today we’d like to introduce to you the first major content update for the game.

Firstly, we’ve added ratings, one for the campaign and one for the PvP. When you build the Grail, which you will be granted by completing the first co-op mission, you will get access to this menu. Ask the old mage for a better understanding of how the score is calculated.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/6eeccd19f0020bf4a8d8d1d898fe7695ba70f610.png[/img]

Secondly, you can now continue to follow the storyline. We have added three new missions with different modes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/083cbb84999e50ebb68e6b66fce1cd7b247cc4a0.png[/img]

Astral. New mode. You must defend the portal using only one hero unit with 4 abilities. In addition, you will face  a new monster in this mission and one really pissed off Boss. 

We have a lot of feedback about the lack of multiplayer maps. So, there are new ones. The cliff is a PvP mission. After completing this one you will get access to 2 new units, Eagles. They are offensive units which can be used only in PvP battles.

The third new map is The Two Mountains, a co-op mission. Monsters come from two different sides. You are defending one path, while your ally is protecting the other one. It’s so much fun!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/bee8f25ce3aeddf6e15ccde759b9db2ac30ba766.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/c66f01ea272f6d4acd63816f230a78c7b4a94299.jpg[/img]

As the player completes story missions, he or she will unlock new rune magic, firewall, new buildings in the town., a lot of new upgrades for units, and so on. Also, we have added 7 new Steam Achievements. They are easy to get. Just the way you like it :D

On top of that, there is a small bonus. We have added a challenge mode for "The Rift" mission.
Have fun.

We have fixed several bugs. There is a changelog.

- The health counter now functions correctly
- Fixed a bug, when camera could got extremely far away from the map when you start a mission
- The health modificator from higher difficulties now works properly in PvP missions
- Fixed a bug, when attack menu from PvP missions could appear in the main menu
- Fixed a bug, when the player couldn't get new spell right after learning "Memory" spell

Join discussions about this update in our hub. We need your feedback to understand which way we should move
http://steamcommunity.com/app/562500/discussions/0/135514231766679743/

Play with us,
Battlecruiser Team

notes.title: Warstone TD. Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26976525/07e2de0587964bcb3c245cec3f5b3a55fa4291c1.jpg[/img]

Hello our players,

We are releasing Warstone in Early Access stage on 29 March at 19:00 CET. The version that we’re releasing into early access is what we consider to be the core of the game. We have decided to add new maps, units, languages and platforms gradually.

We start with 13 of 30 story missions. In this state you can play different maps types: classic, maze, PvP and Co-op. All game classes will be playable.

Once the core game is out and we are sure everything works fine there will still be more to come. The features that we’ll be adding to the game over the next few months include:
[list]
    [*]A finished story campaign
    [*]Two extra difficulties for each mission
    [*]New player's units
    [*]Ability upgrades for strong units
    [*]Magic upgrade system
    [*]New Co-op and PvP missions
    [*]Artifacts system. New consumable items.
    [*]Some maps will be remodelled
    [*]Extra language support. German and Japanese in the beginning
    [*]Extra platform support (Mac/Linux)
[/list]
We are going to complete these goals in approximately 2 months. After that, we will bring Warstone to Full Release. When the game will be in the ideal state we will start the development of the expansion: a new setting and a new storyline, new missions, units, enemies, etc.

In any case we’ll be communicating regularly on the progress of the game here and via FB and such. So you’ll have plenty of patch logs, updates and new information. Not to mention that we’ll be pushing any critical bug-fixes as fast as we can find and fix them.

So stay tuned for more information and please, don’t hesitate to ask questions in the comments or start a discussion thread!

Play with us!
Battlecruiser team
